absolutezero.name: Absolute Zero
absolutezero.desc: Snow Warning + Mold Breaker + Filter. Summons Snow on entry, ignores opposing Abilities when attacking, and reduces damage from super-effective hits.

abysslure.name: Abyss Lure
abysslure.desc: This Pokemon absorbs Electric- and Water-type moves that hit it, restoring 1/4 of its maximum HP and raising its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. It no longer redirects those moves from allies. It also has Illuminate's effect.
abysslure.shortDesc: Volt Absorb + Water Absorb + Illuminate. Absorbs Electric/Water hits; heals 1/4; +1 Atk/SpA; Illuminate; no redirection.

abysssniper.name: Abyss Sniper
abysssniper.desc: This Pokemon has Sniper and Stalwart's effects. Its critical hits deal increased damage, and its moves cannot be redirected.

adaptivecore.name: Adaptive Core
adaptivecore.desc: Download + Defragment + Self Repair. Combines those three effects; Self Sufficient and Natural Cure are part of Self Repair, not separate added components.

adaptivepower.name: Adaptive Power
adaptivepower.desc: This Pokemon has Huge Power, Magic Guard, and Regenerator's effects.

aevianbolt.name: Aevian Bolt
aevianbolt.desc: On entry, Druddigon permanently transforms into Druddigon-Rejuv. This Pokemon also has the effects of Storm Power, Static, and Volt Absorb. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.
aevianbolt.shortDesc: Transforms Druddigon into Druddigon-Rejuv; Storm Power + Static + Volt Absorb.

aeviandream.name: Aevian Dream
aeviandream.desc: This Pokemon has Bad Dreams, Shed Skin, and Tough Claws's effects. When it enters battle as Musharna, it transforms into Musharna-Rejuv. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.
aeviandream.shortDesc: Bad Dreams + Shed Skin + Tough Claws; transforms Musharna into Musharna-Rejuv.

aevianfrost.name: Aevian Frost
aevianfrost.desc: Ice Body + Guts. Filter damage reduction is removed.

aevianglacier.name: Aevian Glacier
aevianglacier.desc: On entry, Turtonator permanently transforms into Turtonator-Rejuv. This Pokemon also has the effects of Snow Warning, Ice Body, and Refrigerate. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.
aevianglacier.shortDesc: Transforms Turtonator into Turtonator-Rejuv; Snow Warning + Ice Body + Refrigerate.

aeviangrief.name: Aevian Grief
aeviangrief.desc: Wonder Skin + Levitate + Magic Guard + Cursed Body. Flare Boost is removed.
aeviangrief.shortDesc: Wonder Skin + Levitate + Magic Guard + Cursed Body.

aevianoath.name: Aevian Oath
aevianoath.desc: This Pokemon has Sworn Duty, Dual Wield, and Battle Armor's effects.
aevianoath.shortDesc: Sworn Duty + Dual Wield + Battle Armor.

aevianrocket.name: Aevian Rocket
aevianrocket.desc: When Veluza enters battle with this Ability, it changes into Veluza-Rejuv. It has Brute Force's Reckless power boost and Rock Head recoil protection, restores 1/3 of its maximum HP on switching out through Regenerator, ignores opposing Abilities with Mold Breaker, and doubles its Speed under Swift Swim's conditions. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.
aevianrocket.shortDesc: Brute Force + Reckless + Rock Head + Regenerator + Mold Breaker + Swift Swim. Transforms Veluza into Veluza-Rejuv; Brute Force + Regenerator + Mold Breaker + Swift Swim.

aevianspark.name: Aevian Spark
aevianspark.desc: Technician + Static + Early Bird. Weak moves gain power, contact may paralyze, and sleep ends faster. Tough Claws is removed.

aeviantoxin.name: Aevian Toxin
aeviantoxin.desc: Strong Jaw + Layered Coat. Merciless is removed; poisoned targets do not receive its critical-hit boost.
aeviantoxin.shortDesc: Strong Jaw + Layered Coat + Fur Coat + Overcoat.

aevianwing.name: Aevian Wing
aevianwing.desc: Rock Head + Defiant. Scrappy is removed, so Normal and Fighting moves no longer bypass Ghost immunity.

alchemistsurge.name: Alchemist Surge
alchemistsurge.desc: Psychic Surge + Competitive + Hydra Bond + Prankster. Psychic Surge follows the existing field/Aura rules: it can create Psychic Terrain on an empty field or Psychic Aura over a compatible field. No Neuroforce.
alchemistsurge.shortDesc: Psychic Surge + Competitive + Hydra Bond + Prankster.

alloycore.name: Alloy Core
alloycore.desc: This Pokemon has Magic Guard, Self Sufficient, and Stalwart's effects.

amethystglow.name: Amethyst Glow
amethystglow.desc: This Pokemon's moves cannot miss and it has Ice Body and Refrigerate's effects. It is treated as an Ice-type Pokemon in Hail and Ice fields.
amethystglow.shortDesc: Moves cannot miss; Ice Body + Refrigerate; Ice in Ice fields.

anchorbridge.name: Anchor Bridge
anchorbridge.desc: Sturdy. When Sturdy saves this Pokemon from a direct hit, its side gains Light Screen for 3 turns. Does not shorten a longer existing screen.
anchorbridge.shortDesc: Sturdy. When Sturdy saves it from a direct hit, its side gains Light Screen for 3 turns. Does not shorten a longer existing screen.

anchoredbattery.name: Anchored Battery
anchoredbattery.desc: Has Mega Launcher's full effect: pulse and bullet moves have 1.5x power. Has Suction Cups' full effect: this Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out. It can still switch voluntarily.
anchoredbattery.shortDesc: Mega Launcher + Suction Cups; pulse/bullet moves gain 1.5x power; blocks forced switching.

ancientbloom.name: Ancient Bloom
ancientbloom.desc: This Pokemon has Effect Spore and Pollen Bloom's effects. Thick Fat applies once through Pollen Bloom: Fire and Ice damage is halved, not quartered. It keeps its field-based Defense, Special Defense, and power boosts.
ancientbloom.shortDesc: Effect Spore + Self Sufficient + Proficient. Effect Spore + Pollen Bloom; Thick Fat applies once; field boosts.

apexarmor.name: Apex Armor
apexarmor.desc: Bulletproof + Rough Skin + Stalwart + Self Sufficient. Blocks bullet/pulse moves, reduces attack damage by 20%, damages contact attackers by 1/8 max HP, and ignores redirection. Restores 1/16 max HP each turn and prevents hail and sandstorm damage.
apexarmor.shortDesc: Bulletproof + Rough Skin + Stalwart + Self Sufficient.

apexbond.name: Apex Bond
apexbond.desc: Battle Bond's shared effects plus Supreme Overlord and Rough Skin. Garchomp-Battle-Bond's Dual Chop never misses and always critically hits.
apexbond.shortDesc: Battle Bond + Filter + Self Sufficient + Supreme Overlord + Rough Skin. Battle Bond + Supreme Overlord + Rough Skin; Dual Chop never misses and always critical.

apexcleave.name: Apex Cleave
apexcleave.desc: This Pokemon has Sharpness, Dual Wield, and Moxie's effects. Slicing moves use a second Dual Wield hit at 20% of their unboosted power.

apexflytrap.name: Apex Flytrap
apexflytrap.desc: The holder is airborne, as with Levitate. Once per switch-in, a foe that damages it with a contact move is trapped through the following turn while the holder remains active.
apexflytrap.shortDesc: Levitate; once per switch-in, traps a foe that hits it with contact through the next turn.

apexpredator.name: Apex Predator
apexpredator.desc: Relic Armor + Dragonize + Wind Rider. Eligible Normal moves become Dragon type. Precision effects are removed.

apexvenom.name: Apex Venom
apexvenom.desc: This Pokemon has Strong Jaw and Shed Skin's effects. Poison moves, including Poison Fang, are super effective against Poison- and Steel-type Pokemon. Poison Fang has 1.5x power. Biting moves bypass protection and have a 30% chance to badly poison the target.
apexvenom.shortDesc: Strong Jaw + Shed Skin; Poison hits Poison/Steel; Poison Fang is 1.5x; bites bypass protection and badly poison 30%.

aquashell.name: Aqua Shell
aquashell.desc: Water Veil + Tough Claws + Inner Focus. Prevents and cures burns, grants Aqua Ring on switch-in, prevents hail and sandstorm damage, and cures status at turn end on Water Surface and Underwater fields. Contact moves have 1.3x power. Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop.
aquashell.shortDesc: Water Veil + Tough Claws + Inner Focus.

argentdevotion.name: Argent Devotion
argentdevotion.desc: Armorize + Sworn Duty + Serene Grace. Eligible Normal moves become Steel, Sworn Duty supports its ally, and move secondary effects are more likely.

armoredadvance.name: Armored Advance
armoredadvance.desc: Its own damaging moves cannot lower its Defense or Sp. Def. Ground attacks ignore its negative offensive stat stages.
armoredadvance.shortDesc: Own moves cannot lower defenses. Ground attacks ignore its offensive stat drops.

asoneglastrier.name: As One (Glastrier)
asoneglastrier.desc: Combination of the Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.
asoneglastrier.shortDesc: Combination of the Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.

asonespectrier.name: As One (Spectrier)
asonespectrier.desc: Combination of the Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.
asonespectrier.shortDesc: Combination of the Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.

astralcore.name: Astral Core
astralcore.desc: This Pokemon has Pure Power, Natural Cure, and Illuminate's effects.

astralengine.name: Astral Engine
astralengine.desc: Elevate + Analytic + Power Spot. Boosts allied move power. Filter is removed.

astralward.name: Astral Ward
astralward.desc: Magic Bounce + Telepathy. Reflects eligible status moves and avoids allied damaging moves.

astralwatcher.name: Astral Watcher
astralwatcher.desc: Defragment + Frisk + Prankster. Telepathy is removed; allied damaging moves can hit it.

astralwitchcraft.name: Astral Witchcraft
astralwitchcraft.desc: Proficient + Magic Guard + Magic Bounce + Levitate. Reflects eligible status moves. Sworn Duty is removed.
astralwitchcraft.shortDesc: Proficient + Magic Guard + Magic Bounce + Levitate.

atrocity.name: Atrocity
atrocity.desc: Unbound Blaze + Self Sufficient + Levitate + Proficient; boosts critical hits. Dragon Rush never misses. It does not drain HP or bypass abilities, screens, Veil, or Substitute.
atrocity.shortDesc: Unbound Blaze + Self Sufficient + Levitate + Proficient; boosts critical hits.

aurainstinct.name: Aura Instinct
aurainstinct.desc: This Pokemon has Adaptability, Dual Wield, and Second Wind's effects.

auramaster.name: Aura Master
auramaster.desc: This Pokemon takes half damage from contact moves and has Dual Wield, Inner Focus, and Technician's effects.
auramaster.shortDesc: 0.5x from contact; Dual Wield + Inner Focus + Technician.

auroracurrent.name: Aurora Current
auroracurrent.desc: This Pokemon has Snow Warning built in. On switch-in, it summons Snow. It gains STAB on Electric-type moves. During Snow, its Electric-type moves cannot miss and its Defense and Special Defense are boosted by 1.5x.
auroracurrent.shortDesc: Snow Warning; Electric STAB; in Snow, Electric never misses and Def/SpD 1.5x.

auroradomain.name: Aurora Domain
auroradomain.desc: Snow Warning + Relic Armor + Refrigerate + Self Sufficient. Does not set Aurora Veil on entry; Aurora Veil can still be used manually. On faint, sets Fairy Tale and refreshes Aurora Veil for 5 turns. Shows "The Aurora will persist".
auroradomain.shortDesc: Snow Warning + Relic Armor + Refrigerate + Self Sufficient; Veil on faint.

auroraresonance.name: Aurora Resonance
auroraresonance.desc: Liquid Voice + Water Absorb + Ice Body + Rain Dish. Sound moves become Water type, Water attacks are absorbed, and the holder heals in rain and snow. Does not add Ice typing.
auroraresonance.shortDesc: Liquid Voice + Water Absorb + Ice Body + Rain Dish.

bakedbliss.name: Baked Bliss
bakedbliss.desc: This Pokemon has Well-Baked Body, Thick Fat, Sweet Veil, and Gluttony's effects.
bakedbliss.shortDesc: Well-Baked Body + Thick Fat + Sweet Veil + Gluttony.

barbharvest.name: Barb Harvest
barbharvest.desc: Iron Barbs. After taking three opposing contact moves, restores its consumed Berry once per battle, if its item slot is empty. Multi-hit attacks count as one move; progress persists through switching.
barbharvest.shortDesc: Iron Barbs; restores its used Berry after three opposing contact attacks, once per battle.

battlebond.name: Battle Bond
battlebond.desc: A KO can trigger a Bond form; no lethal-hit survival. Eligible Arcanine, Garchomp, and Greninja forms transform after a KO. It no longer leaves the holder at 1 HP from a lethal hit.
battlebond.shortDesc: Filter + Self Sufficient. A KO can trigger a Bond form; no lethal-hit survival.

bedrockclaw.name: Bedrock Claw
bedrockclaw.desc: Tough Claws. The first Ground-type contact attack to damage a foe each switch-in removes one opposing screen after damage.
bedrockclaw.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first Ground contact hit per entry breaks a screen.

bewitchingmajesty.name: Bewitching Majesty
bewitchingmajesty.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon creates Bewitched Woods for 5 turns. This Pokemon has Magic Bounce and Queenly Majesty's effects.
bewitchingmajesty.shortDesc: Sets Bewitched Woods for 5 turns. Magic Bounce + Queenly Majesty.

beyondfear.name: Beyond Fear
beyondfear.desc: Inner Focus. Once per switch-in, an opposing Attack increase grants +1 Defense, or an opposing Sp. Atk increase grants +1 Sp. Def. A move raising both grants both, consuming the one activation.
beyondfear.shortDesc: Inner Focus; an opposing offensive boost grants a matching defensive boost once per entry.

blackfang.name: Black Fang
blackfang.desc: This Pokemon has Strong Jaw, Insomnia, and Moxie's effects.

blackviper.name: Black Viper
blackviper.desc: Whiplash: +1 accuracy on entry and 1.5x tail-move power. Its first tail hit against a foe each entry badly poisons that target, subject to normal status immunities.
blackviper.shortDesc: Whiplash; the first tail hit each entry badly poisons.

blademastery.name: Blade Mastery
blademastery.desc: This Pokemon has Sharpness and Super Luck. Below half HP, its slicing moves have +1 priority.
blademastery.shortDesc: Sharpness + Super Luck; below half HP, slicing moves gain +1 priority.

blastchamber.name: Blast Chamber
blastchamber.desc: Vital Spirit, including sleep immunity, 1.3x Fighting attack-stat boost and 20% direct-damage reduction. A landed Fire attack makes its next Fighting attack unable to miss, and a landed Fighting attack does the same for its next Fire attack. Charges end on switching.
blastchamber.shortDesc: Vital Spirit; Fire and Fighting hits make the other type's next attack never miss.

blazingmane.name: Blazing Mane
blazingmane.desc: Fire attacks have 1.5x power and damaging moves hit twice, with the second hit at 30% power. At half HP or less, Fire attacks gain +1 priority. Burning and Volcanic Fields raise its Speed by 1 on entry or when the field starts.
blazingmane.shortDesc: Proficient. Fire 1.5x; second hit 30%; half-HP Fire +1 priority; fire fields +1 Spe.

blazingtempo.name: Blazing Tempo
blazingtempo.desc: Speed Boost + Proficient + Striker + Magma Armor + Keen Eye. Gains +1 Speed at the end of each eligible turn; same-type moves have 1.3x power and kicking moves have 1.4x power. Prevents freezing and Accuracy drops, and ignores the target's evasiveness. Magma Armor and Keen Eye also retain their field effects.
blazingtempo.shortDesc: Speed Boost + Proficient + Striker + Magma Armor + Keen Eye.

bloodchallenge.name: Blood Challenge
bloodchallenge.desc: Its first opposing direct hit each entry deals 25% less damage. Counter can retaliate against either physical or special attacks.
bloodchallenge.shortDesc: First direct hit per entry deals 25% less damage; Counter also answers special hits.

bloomingsun.name: Blooming Sun
bloomingsun.desc: This Pokemon has Mega Sol, Invigorate, and Natural Cure's effects.
bloomingsun.shortDesc: Mega Sol + Invigorate + Natural Cure + Proficient.

bogbody.name: Bog Body
bogbody.desc: This Pokemon has Thick Fat, Levitate, and Dry Skin's effects.

bonewarrior.name: Bone Warrior
bonewarrior.desc: This Pokemon has Battle Armor and Self Sufficient's effects.

boretunnel.name: Bore Tunnel
boretunnel.desc: Has Earth Eater's full effect. The first Ground-type move it absorbs each switch-in also removes Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and G-Max Steelsurge from its own side.
boretunnel.shortDesc: Earth Eater; first Ground absorption each switch-in clears own-side hazards.

breakaway.name: Breakaway
breakaway.desc: Once per switch-in, surviving an opposing physical hit lowers Defense by 1 stage and raises Speed by 2 stages.
breakaway.shortDesc: Once per entry, surviving a physical hit gives -1 Defense and +2 Speed.

breakwater.name: Breakwater
breakwater.desc: Full Propeller Tail: moves cannot be redirected and Speed doubles on Water Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Once per switch-in, a directly selected non-pivot physical Water move that deals opposing HP damage clears entry hazards from this Pokemon's side. Flip Turn, substitutes, misses, protection, called and future attacks do not trigger it. The allowance is spent only when hazards are cleared.
breakwater.shortDesc: Propeller Tail; once per entry, direct non-pivot physical Water HP damage clears own hazards.

broodguard.name: Broodguard
broodguard.desc: Thick Fat + Friend Guard. Once per switch-in, when an adjacent ally survives an opposing hit that takes it from above half HP to half or less, this Pokemon gains +1 Defense.
broodguard.shortDesc: Thick Fat + Friend Guard; an ally dropping below half HP grants +1 Defense.

bruteforce.name: Brute Force
bruteforce.desc: This Pokemon has Reckless and Rock Head's effects.

bullrush.name: Bull Rush
bullrush.desc: Violent Rush + Intimidate. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack. On its first active turn, Speed rises 50% and Attack 20%.

burningcrown.name: Burning Crown
burningcrown.desc: This Pokemon has Intimidate, White Smoke, Mold Breaker, Unbound Blaze, Self Sufficient, and Proficient. It takes 20% less damage from all damaging attacks. Self Sufficient restores 1/16 base maximum HP at turn end and prevents sandstorm and hail damage. Proficient boosts damaging attacks matching its type by 1.3x. It gains no boosts when a Pokemon faints. Its field bonuses remain active.
burningcrown.shortDesc: Intimidate + White Smoke + Mold Breaker + Unbound Blaze + Self Sufficient + Proficient; attacks deal 20% less; no KO boost.

burningego.name: Burning Ego
burningego.desc: Proficient + Ultra Ego + Flame Body + Thick Fat. Same-type moves have 1.3x power; it heals and gains Attack and Sp. Atk when fighting, can burn contact attackers, and halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
burningego.shortDesc: Proficient + Ultra Ego + Flame Body + Thick Fat.

burningrage.name: Burning Rage
burningrage.desc: This Pokemon has Brute Force, Iron Fist, and Turboblaze's effects.
burningrage.shortDesc: Proficient. Brute Force + Iron Fist + Turboblaze.

burningspirit.name: Burning Spirit
burningspirit.desc: This Pokemon has Self Sufficient, Opportunist, Magma Armor, and Proficient's effects.
burningspirit.shortDesc: Self Sufficient + Opportunist + Magma Armor + Proficient.

calderacore.name: Caldera Core
calderacore.desc: Sheer Force + Drought + Magma Armor. Solid Rock damage reduction is removed.

caverndrake.name: Cavern Drake
caverndrake.desc: This Pokemon has Earth Eater, Solid Rock, and Mold Breaker's effects.
caverndrake.shortDesc: Earth Eater + Solid Rock + Mold Breaker.

celestialheart.name: Celestial Heart
celestialheart.desc: Soul-Heart + Friend Guard + Serene Grace. Faints raise the holder's stats; allies take less damage; secondary effects are more likely. No Multiscale.

coldlogic.name: Cold Logic
coldlogic.desc: Tough Claws + Prism Armor + Aftermath + Forewarn. Contact moves hit harder, super-effective damage is reduced, contact attackers take damage if this Pokemon is knocked out, and the strongest opposing move is revealed on entry.
coldlogic.shortDesc: Tough Claws + Prism Armor + Aftermath + Forewarn.

completeparasitism.name: Complete Parasitism
completeparasitism.desc: Parasitism, Filter, and Self Repair. A lethal hit triggers a full-HP revival as Parasect-Parasite at the end of the turn, even if Parasitism was used before Mega Evolution.
completeparasitism.shortDesc: Parasitism + Dry Skin + Filter + Self Repair. Parasitism + Filter + Self Repair; Mega can revive as Parasite.

corneredfang.name: Cornered Fang
corneredfang.desc: Guts. Once per switch-in, the first biting move selected while at half HP or less has +1 priority. Using that move spends the priority effect even if it misses or is blocked.
corneredfang.shortDesc: Guts; at half HP, the first biting move each entry gains +1 priority.

corrosiveburn.name: Corrosive Burn
corrosiveburn.desc: This Pokemon has Merciless, Regenerator, and Corrosion's effects.

corrosivetouch.name: Corrosive Touch
corrosivetouch.desc: Technician + Poison Touch + Corrosion. Moves with 60 or less power receive a 1.5x boost (80 or less on Factory Field). Contact attacks have a 30% chance to poison. Can poison Poison- and Steel-types; Poison attacks can hit Steel-types. Poisoning a foe lowers its Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Includes Corrosion field effects. Grass attacks receive a 1.5x same-type attack bonus.
corrosivetouch.shortDesc: Technician + Poison Touch + Corrosion; Grass STAB.

crosscurrent.name: Crosscurrent
crosscurrent.desc: Has Swift Swim's full effect, doubling Speed in rain and qualifying water fields. After this Pokemon damages a foe, its next damaging move has 1.3x power if it uses the opposite category, Physical or Special. Misses and status moves do not change the last landed category. This bonus does not stack with itself.
crosscurrent.shortDesc: Swift Swim; alternating landed Physical and Special attacks gain 1.3x power.

cruelshell.name: Cruel Shell
cruelshell.desc: This Pokemon has Hyper Cutter, Shell Armor, and Anger Shell's effects.
cruelshell.shortDesc: Hyper Cutter + Shell Armor + Anger Shell.

crueltag.name: Cruel Tag
crueltag.desc: Shadow Tag + Infiltrator + Bad Dreams. Traps adjacent foes, bypasses screens and Substitute, and damages sleeping foes each turn.

crystalresonance.name: Crystal Resonance
crystalresonance.desc: This Pokemon has Amethyst Glow and Magic Bounce's effects.

currentcoil.name: Current Coil
currentcoil.desc: Swift Swim, including this server's eligible water fields. Coil additionally raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage, preserving its other boosts.
currentcoil.shortDesc: Swift Swim; Coil also raises Sp. Atk.

cursedarmament.name: Cursed Armament
cursedarmament.desc: This Pokemon has Filter's effects. Curse used by this Pokemon becomes a 100 BP physical or special Ghost-type attack using its higher Attack or Special Attack, with 100% accuracy, that hits all adjacent foes and curses each target. Curse from this Pokemon deals 1/8 max HP each turn. This Pokemon restores 1/4 of the damage dealt by its attacks and by Curse damage it caused. When this Pokemon reaches half HP or faints, it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns.
cursedarmament.shortDesc: Filter; Curse becomes a 100 BP spread Ghost attack using the higher Attack or Sp. Atk; curses foes; heals 1/4 damage; half HP/faint sets Haunted Field.

curseddoll.name: Cursed Doll
curseddoll.desc: This Pokemon has Tough Claws and Shadow Shield's effects. Its damaging moves curse the foes they hurt. When it faints, it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns.
curseddoll.shortDesc: Tough Claws + Shadow Shield; damaging moves curse; faint sets Haunted.

cursedmarionette.name: Cursed Marionette
cursedmarionette.desc: This Pokemon's status moves have +1 priority. Its attacks and status moves curse opposing targets, and being hit curses the attacker. Cursed foes deal 0.8x damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon restores HP equal to 1/2 of Curse damage it caused. Its Curse deals 1/8 max HP. When it faints, opposing Pokemon become cursed and it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns, ignoring Neutralization.
cursedmarionette.shortDesc: Prankster; attacks/status curse; cursed foes deal 0.8x; heals 1/2 Curse damage.

darkdominion.name: Dark Dominion
darkdominion.desc: Dark Aura. Damaging Dark hits inflict Heal Block on surviving foes for 2 turns, including the current turn. Respects protection and Substitute; does not shorten a longer existing Heal Block.
darkdominion.shortDesc: Dark Aura; Dark hits Heal Block surviving foes for 2 turns.

debilitatingvenom.name: Debilitating Venom
debilitatingvenom.desc: This Pokemon can poison Steel- and Poison-type targets while other status protections still apply. Steel remains immune to Poison-type attack damage. When its damaging Poison move hits an already-poisoned opposing Pokemon's HP, that target's Attack falls by 1 stage once per turn.
debilitatingvenom.shortDesc: Can poison Steel/Poison types; Poison HP hits lower poisoned foes' Attack once per turn.

defeatist.name: Defeatist
defeatist.desc: While this Pokemon has 1/4 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack and Special Attack are halved. This Pokemon also has Relic Armor's effect.
defeatist.shortDesc: At 1/4 HP or less, Atk/SpA are halved; also has Relic Armor.

desertrift.name: Desert Rift
desertrift.desc: Combines Sand Force, Sand Stream, and Heavy Metal. On entry, summons a sandstorm and creates Desert Field for 5 turns. Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type attacks gain 30% power during sandstorm or Desert Field. It is immune to sandstorm damage, has doubled weight, and takes half damage from physical moves. Its four moves are always Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Earthquake, and Stone Edge.
desertrift.shortDesc: Sand Force + Sand Stream + Heavy Metal; 5-turn Desert Field; fixed four-move set.

desertshell.name: Desert Shell
desertshell.desc: This Pokemon has Skill Link, Heatproof, and Sand Stream's effects. Multi-hit moves always hit the maximum number of times and have 1.5x power. Damage from Fire-type moves and burns is halved. Summons sandstorm on entry.

desertspirit.name: Desert Spirit
desertspirit.desc: This Pokemon has Levitate, Sand Stream, and Tinted Lens's effects. It is airborne, summons sandstorm on entry, and deals double damage with resisted attacks. Its Ground-type attacks receive STAB even though it is not Ground-type.
desertspirit.shortDesc: Levitate + Sand Stream + Tinted Lens; Ground moves get STAB.

digestivesap.name: Digestive Sap
digestivesap.desc: Direct Poison-type attacks heal this Pokemon for 1/3 of actual opposing HP damage, capped at 1/8 of its maximum HP per turn across all hits and targets. Native draining moves do not receive additional healing. Does not drain substitutes, allies, or delayed attacks; normal healing prevention and Liquid Ooze apply.
digestivesap.shortDesc: Poison attacks drain 1/3 actual foe HP damage; healing capped at 1/8 max HP each turn.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.desc: If this Pokemon is a Mimikyu, its status moves have +1 priority while its disguise is intact. The first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage, curses the attacker, breaks the disguise, changes it to Busted Form, and makes it lose 1/8 of its max HP. Curse inflicted by Disguise deals 1/8 max HP each turn. After its disguise is broken, attackers that hit it with damaging moves become cursed. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.
disguise.shortDesc: Intact: status +1. First hit is blocked/curses; busted hit curses foes for 1/8.

divineintervention.name: Divine Intervention
divineintervention.desc: This Pokemon has Sworn Duty, Friend Guard, Regenerator, and Fluffy's effects.
divineintervention.shortDesc: Sworn Duty + Friend Guard + Regenerator + Fluffy.

divinemockery.name: Divine Mockery
divinemockery.desc: This Pokemon has Hydra Bond, Mold Breaker, and Sniper's effects. Eligible attacks gain Hydra Bond's extra hits and ignore opposing Abilities. It gains +1 accuracy on entry and its critical hits deal more damage. Water attacks receive STAB even without Water typing.
divinemockery.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Mold Breaker + Sniper; Water STAB.

doomwarning.name: Doom Warning
doomwarning.desc: This Pokemon has Magic Bounce and Magic Guard. When it faints, Doom Desire is cast on every opposing Pokemon.
doomwarning.shortDesc: Magic Bounce + Magic Guard; faint casts Doom Desire.

doublestrike.name: Double Strike
doublestrike.desc: Skill Link maximizes eligible multi-hit moves. Moves with 60 or less effective base power (80 or less on Factory Field) gain 1.5x power, punching moves gain 1.4x power. These bonuses stack.
doublestrike.shortDesc: Iron Fist + Technician + Skill Link. Skill Link; stacking boosts to weaker and punching moves.

dozinggiant.name: Dozing Giant
dozinggiant.desc: Oblivious. While asleep, takes 25% less damage from special attacks. Sleep Talk cannot select Rest.
dozinggiant.shortDesc: Oblivious. While asleep, takes 25% less damage from special attacks. Sleep Talk cannot select Rest.

draconicforce.name: Draconic Force
draconicforce.desc: This Pokemon has Dragonize, Strong Jaw, and Mold Breaker's effects.
draconicforce.shortDesc: Dragonize + Strong Jaw + Mold Breaker + Proficient.

dreadjaw.name: Dread Jaw
dreadjaw.desc: Moxie. A move KO also stores one charge that lowers the next opposing entrant's Attack by 1 stage. Charges do not stack and end when the holder leaves.
dreadjaw.shortDesc: Moxie; a move KO lowers the next opposing entrant's Attack.

dreadmaw.name: Dread Maw
dreadmaw.desc: Huge Power + Frisk + Invigorate. Doubles Attack, reveals opposing held items on entry, and improves healing.

dreamsickness.name: Dream Sickness
dreamsickness.desc: Retains Telepathy, including avoiding allied damaging moves and doubled Speed in Psychic Terrain or Psychic Aura. At the end of each turn, it and its active allies each heal 1/16 max HP. Once per switch-in, if an opposing move would knock out an ally, that ally survives at 1 HP and this Pokemon loses 1/4 max HP, provided it has more HP than the cost.
dreamsickness.shortDesc: Telepathy; heals its side 1/16 each turn; once per switch-in saves an ally from a lethal hit at a 1/4 HP cost.

dreepyvanguard.name: Dreepy Vanguard
dreepyvanguard.desc: Full Stalwart, including its field effects. Once per entry, the first Dragon Darts dealing opposing HP damage removes Reflect if Physical or Light Screen if Special from each opposing side it damaged, after both darts finish. Uses Dragon Darts' actual higher-offense category. Ability changes do not refresh this effect.
dreepyvanguard.shortDesc: Stalwart. Once per entry, Dragon Darts damage breaks the matching screen.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain Dance.
drizzle.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain Dance.

drought.name: Drought
drought.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sunny Day.
drought.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sunny Day.

dryskin.name: Dry Skin
dryskin.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move. The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain Dance, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sunny Day. The weather effects are prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
dryskin.shortDesc: This Pokemon is healed 1/4 by Water, 1/8 by Rain; is hurt 1.25x by Fire, 1/8 by Sun.

dunerunner.name: Dune Runner
dunerunner.desc: Sand Rush. Once per switch-in, being active in sandstorm clears entry hazards from its side. Retains Sand Rush's weather and field Speed effects.
dunerunner.shortDesc: Sand Rush; entering during sand clears its side's hazards once.

duneterror.name: Dune Terror
duneterror.desc: Sand Stream + Shed Skin + Sand Spit. Summons sand on entry and when hit; during Sandstorm, opposing Pokemon take Ground-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Ground immunities. On fainting, creates Desert Field for 5 turns.
duneterror.shortDesc: Sand Stream + Shed Skin + Sand Spit; Desert Field for 5 turns on faint.

duskdrive.name: Dusk Drive
duskdrive.desc: This Pokemon has Precision, Opportunist, and Battle Fervor built in.

echosense.name: Echo Sense
echosense.desc: This Pokemon has Echo Fiend, Frisk, Telepathy, and Infiltrator's effects.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.desc: This Ability cannot be suppressed. During weather, this Pokemon's attacks deal 1.5x damage. In clear weather, attacks deal 0.5x damage to this Pokemon. Its Psychic-type moves become Dark type if Dark would do more damage, and its Dark-type moves become Psychic type if Psychic would do more damage. It restores 1/4 max HP instead of taking damage from Psychic- or Dark-type moves.
eclipse.shortDesc: Cannot be suppressed; weather attacks 1.5x; clear damage halved; Psychic/Dark choose type.

emperorsresolve.name: Emperor's Resolve
emperorsresolve.desc: This Pokemon has Competitive, Slush Rush, Swift Swim, and Proficient's effects. Its Speed doubles in rain, snow, and the fields supported by either rush ability; these boosts do not stack.
emperorsresolve.shortDesc: Competitive + Slush Rush + Swift Swim + Proficient.

empress.name: Empress
empress.desc: This Pokemon has Queenly Majesty and Royal Decree's effects, gains normal STAB on Fighting-type moves, and ignores the Fairy-type component of Poison- and Steel-type weaknesses. Neutralization suppresses only its Royal Decree effects; Queenly Majesty still works.
empress.shortDesc: Queenly Majesty + Royal Decree; Fighting STAB; ignores Fairy's Poison/Steel weakness.

encorearia.name: Encore Aria
encorearia.desc: Serene Grace. Once per switch-in, successfully applying a move secondary effect creates Safeguard for 5 turns. A blocked secondary does not trigger this effect.
encorearia.shortDesc: Serene Grace; the first secondary effect each entry sets 5-turn Safeguard.

enlightenment.name: Enlightenment
enlightenment.desc: This Pokemon has Pure Power, Inner Focus, and Technician's effects.

exalt.name: Exalt
exalt.desc: This Pokemon has Defiant's effect and gains STAB on Ice- and Flying-type moves.
exalt.shortDesc: Defiant; Ice and Flying moves get STAB.

execution.name: Execution
execution.desc: Duskilate. Attacks against targets at half HP or less gain 1.3x power. Once per switch-in, a direct hit that brings a surviving foe from above half HP to half or less marks it; the next Dark or Ghost hit against that foe ignores positive defensive boosts and spends the mark. The mark ends if either Pokemon switches. Restores 1/8 maximum HP per KO; Attack and Sp. Atk cannot fall below -1, and Speed cannot be lowered while a field is active. Retains Duskilate field effects.
execution.shortDesc: Duskilate; stronger against low-HP foes; a hit crossing half HP marks them for defense bypass.

fallenstar.name: Fallen Star
fallenstar.desc: Arrow moves gain 1.3x power against trapped foes. No Skill Link effect. Retains its arrow follow-up and protective effects.
fallenstar.shortDesc: Mold Breaker + Dual Wield + Self Sufficient + Proficient. Arrow moves gain 1.3x power against trapped foes.

falsedevotion.name: False Devotion
falsedevotion.desc: This Pokemon has Serene Grace, Natural Recovery, and Prankster's effects.
falsedevotion.shortDesc: Built-in Serene Grace, Natural Recovery, and Prankster.

fightingfiend.name: Fighting Fiend
fightingfiend.desc: This Pokemon has Vital Spirit and Multiscale's effects, and its moves cannot miss.
fightingfiend.shortDesc: Vital Spirit + Multiscale; moves cannot miss.

flashfire.name: Flash Fire
flashfire.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.
flashfire.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Fire attacks do 1.5x damage if hit by one Fire move; Fire immunity.

floehunter.name: Floe Hunter
floehunter.desc: Slush Rush. In snow or hail, biting moves always critically hit slower targets, unless critical hits are prevented.
floehunter.shortDesc: Slush Rush; bites always crit slower foes in snow or hail, unless blocked.

fluffycraft.name: Fluffy Craft
fluffycraft.desc: This Pokemon has Fluffy and Technician's effects.

fluffyevo.name: Fluffy Evo
fluffyevo.desc: Moves that do not match this Pokemon's type gain STAB. Its damaging moves ignore type immunities while respecting resistances, and it has Overcoat's effects.
fluffyevo.shortDesc: Off-type moves gain STAB; hits type immunities; Overcoat.

forestsurge.name: Forest Surge
forestsurge.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon sets Forest Terrain and Grassy Aura for 5 turns, or 8 turns with Amplifield Rock. It also has Proficient's effect.
forestsurge.shortDesc: Forest and Grassy Aura: 5 turns (8 with Amplifield Rock); Proficient.

forgegrit.name: Forge Grit
forgegrit.desc: Has Guts's full effect: status raises Attack by 50% and burn does not weaken physical attacks. Once per switch-in, the first damaging move it takes from a foe while statused raises its Defense by one stage.
forgegrit.shortDesc: Guts; first foe hit taken while statused each switch-in raises Defense by 1.

fortressshell.name: Fortress Shell
fortressshell.desc: This Pokemon has Shell Armor and Water Barrage's effects, plus Power Spot and Friend Guard. In Electric Terrain, Murkwater Surface, Water Surface, Underwater, Factory, and Short Circuit fields, incoming Electric moves are blocked and redirected to it, raising its Attack and Special Attack by 1. Fairy Tale, New World, Cold Eclipse, and Starlight Arena give it +1 Defense and +1 Special Defense once per active terrain. New World, Cold Eclipse, and Starlight Arena also boost its move power by 1.5x.
fortressshell.shortDesc: Proficient. Shell Armor + Water Barrage; field Electric absorption; ally support.

fortunatewing.name: Fortunate Wing
fortunatewing.desc: Super Luck. Once per switch-in, its first critical hit to damage a foe creates Safeguard for 5 turns. Does not shorten an existing longer Safeguard.
fortunatewing.shortDesc: Super Luck; the first critical hit each entry sets Safeguard for 5 turns.

fossilfrenzy.name: Fossil Frenzy
fossilfrenzy.desc: When this Pokemon is hit by a damaging move, its Attack and Speed rise by 1 stage and it becomes confused. While confused, it takes 1.25x damage from attacks. This Pokemon has Klutz's effect. If it hits itself in confusion, it also loses 1/8 of its maximum HP.
fossilfrenzy.shortDesc: Hit: +1 Atk/Spe and confusion; confusion takes 1.25x; Klutz; self-hit costs 1/8.

fossilram.name: Fossil Ram
fossilram.desc: Rock Head. Once per turn, damaging a foe with a recoil move lowers its Speed by 1 stage. Struggle recoil is not prevented.
fossilram.shortDesc: Rock Head; once per turn, recoil-move damage lowers the foe’s Speed.

freezerburn.name: Freezer Burn
freezerburn.desc: Slush Rush + Refrigerate + Strong Jaw + Levitate. Speed rises in snow; eligible Normal moves become Ice, biting moves gain power, and this Pokemon is airborne.
freezerburn.shortDesc: Slush Rush + Refrigerate + Strong Jaw + Levitate.

frightfulwings.name: Frightful Wings
frightfulwings.desc: This Pokemon has Intimidate: on entry, it lowers adjacent opponents' Attack by 1 stage, respecting Intimidate's normal protections. Its Water-type attacks receive at least a 1.5x same-type attack bonus, even if it is not Water-type. This does not stack with existing Water STAB or reduce a stronger STAB bonus.
frightfulwings.shortDesc: Intimidate; Water attacks receive at least 1.5x STAB without stacking.

frostrunner.name: Frost Runner
frostrunner.desc: Slush Rush. While hail or snow is active, entry hazards cannot damage, poison, or lower this Pokemon's Speed. Retains Slush Rush's field effects.
frostrunner.shortDesc: Slush Rush. While hail or snow is active, entry hazards cannot damage, poison, or lower its Speed. Retains Slush Rush's field effects.

frostsiren.name: Frost Siren
frostsiren.desc: This Pokemon has Refrigerate, Forewarn, and Dry Skin's effects.

frostsovereign.name: Frost Sovereign
frostsovereign.desc: On entry, this Pokemon sets Snow through Snow Warning for 8 turns. It has Ice Body and Filter. Manually used Aurora Veil lasts 8 turns. Each turn, non-immune foes take Ice damage equal to 1/16 max HP. Only in Free-for-All does Ice type effectiveness scale this chip.
frostsovereign.shortDesc: Snow Warning + Ice Body + Filter. 8-turn Snow; Ice Body + Filter; Ice chip scales by type in FFA.

froststalker.name: Frost Stalker
froststalker.desc: Stakeout + Sharpness + Refrigerate. Doubles attacking stats against foes that just entered battle. Slicing moves have 1.5x power except on Cold Eclipse. Eligible Normal moves become Ice with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain fields.

furnaceengine.name: Furnace Engine
furnaceengine.desc: Steam Engine + Flame Body + Self Sufficient + Solid Rock. If this Pokemon dealt Fire- or Rock-type move damage to opposing HP that turn, at the end of the turn opposing Pokemon take Fire-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Fire immunities. Only in Free-for-All does Fire type effectiveness scale this chip.
furnaceengine.shortDesc: Steam Engine + Flame Body + Self Sufficient + Solid Rock; earned Fire chip.

galebloom.name: Gale Bloom
galebloom.desc: Once per switch-in, its first Flying attack to damage a foe raises an adjacent ally's Sp. Atk by 1 stage.
galebloom.shortDesc: First Flying hit per entry boosts an adjacent ally’s Sp. Atk.

galvanicspirit.name: Galvanic Spirit
galvanicspirit.desc: Vital Spirit, including this server's sleep immunity, 1.3x Fighting attack-stat boost and 20% direct-damage reduction. Contact Electric hits lower the foe's Sp. Def by 1 stage once per turn.
galvanicspirit.shortDesc: Vital Spirit; Electric contact hits lower Sp. Def once per turn.

gemeye.name: Gem Eye
gemeye.desc: Keen Eye. Once per switch-in, reflects the first reflectable opposing status move aimed directly at this Pokemon. Side-targeting hazards do not use this reflection.
gemeye.shortDesc: Keen Eye; reflects the first direct opposing status move each entry.

gigavolt.name: Gigavolt
gigavolt.desc: Mold Breaker + Lightning Rod + Static. This Pokemon's moves ignore opposing Abilities. Electric attacks targeting it are redirected to it and raise its Attack and Special Attack instead of dealing damage. Contact attackers may be paralyzed.

glacialheart.name: Glacial Heart
glacialheart.desc: Thermal Exchange + Ice Body + Stalwart. Fire hits raise Attack, burns are prevented, and certain hot fields raise Attack each turn. Snow, hail, and icy fields restore HP; contact attackers may freeze. Attacks track their targets through redirection. Stalwart also raises Special Attack on entry on New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale, and Chessboard fields.

glacialmass.name: Glacial Mass
glacialmass.desc: This Pokemon has Heavy Metal and Thick Fat's effects.

goldentalons.name: Golden Talons
goldentalons.desc: Stalwart + Good as Gold + Sharpness. Its moves ignore redirection, opposing status moves cannot affect it, and slicing moves gain Sharpness's power boost.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.desc: When this Pokemon is hit by an opposing damaging move, once per attacking move, the attacker's Speed is lowered by 2 stages, or 4 stages on Murkwater Surface. This Pokemon also has Hydration and Sap Sipper's effects.
gooey.shortDesc: Damaging hit: attacker -2 Spe (-4 on Murkwater); Hydration + Sap Sipper.

grandmaster.name: Grandmaster
grandmaster.desc: Automatically marks the target of a direct damaging Psychic move with Miracle Eye. Successful direct single-target attacks store a 90 BP Psychic special attack; opposing special HP damage stores a 90 BP special attack of the incoming type. One shared pending attack, arriving two turns later. Stored attacks snapshot this Pokemon's level, Special Attack, stages and typing, survive switching or fainting, and respect live target defenses. Independent of normal Future Sight. Retains flinch, powder and weather protection, status-turn guard, and its existing Psychic resistance and manual Miracle Eye utility.
grandmaster.shortDesc: Automatic Miracle Eye; one stored 90 BP attack after 2 turns; independent of Future Sight.

gravewind.name: Gravewind
gravewind.desc: Sand Rush. Entering directly into a fainted teammate's slot summons sandstorm for 3 turns. Does not shorten or refresh an existing sandstorm.
gravewind.shortDesc: Sand Rush; entering a fainted ally's slot summons sand for 3 turns.

greatmarsh.name: Great Marsh
greatmarsh.desc: Anticipation + Dry Skin + Adaptability. Poison Touch is removed.

gritgrappler.name: Grit Grappler
gritgrappler.desc: Guts. While statused, damaging a foe with a Fighting move restores 1/16 maximum HP once per turn.
gritgrappler.shortDesc: Guts. While statused, damaging a foe with a Fighting move restores 1/16 HP once per turn.

groundingtail.name: Grounding Tail
groundingtail.desc: Once per entry, the first Electric attack dealing opposing HP damage removes Sticky Web from the user's side. No Ground immunity or Speed boost. Ability changes do not refresh this effect.
groundingtail.shortDesc: Once per entry, Electric damage clears Sticky Web from its side.

guidingomen.name: Guiding Omen
guidingomen.desc: Friend Guard + Serene Grace. Once per switch-in, successfully applying a move secondary effect creates a ward that blocks the next opposing stat-drop event against an adjacent ally. Retains both components' effects.
guidingomen.shortDesc: Friend Guard + Serene Grace; first secondary effect shields an ally from a stat drop.

gulpmissile.name: Gulp Missile
gulpmissile.desc: If this Pokemon is a Cramorant, it changes forme when it hits a target with Surf or uses the first turn of Dive successfully. It becomes Gulping Form with an Arrokuda in its mouth if it has more than 1/2 of its maximum HP remaining, or Gorging Form with a Pikachu in its mouth if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP remaining. If Cramorant gets hit in Gulping or Gorging Form, it spits the Arrokuda or Pikachu at its attacker, even if it has no HP remaining. The projectile deals damage equal to 1/4 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down; this damage is blocked by the Magic Guard Ability but not by a substitute. An Arrokuda also lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage, and a Pikachu paralyzes the target. Cramorant will return to normal if it spits out a projectile, switches out, or Dynamaxes.
gulpmissile.shortDesc: When hit after Surf/Dive, attacker takes 1/4 max HP and -1 Defense or paralysis.

hauntedchime.name: Haunted Chime
hauntedchime.desc: This Pokemon has Elevate, Wind Power, and Cursed Body's effects.

headlongresolve.name: Headlong Resolve
headlongresolve.desc: Recoil moves ignore positive defensive boosts. Surviving its own recoil raises Defense by 1 stage once per turn.
headlongresolve.shortDesc: Recoil moves ignore defense boosts; surviving recoil gives +1 Defense once per turn.

heatcoil.name: Heat Coil
heatcoil.desc: This Pokemon has Speed Boost, Magma Armor, and Flame Body's effects.
heatcoil.shortDesc: Speed Boost + Magma Armor + Flame Body.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.desc: If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon takes half of the usual burn damage, rounded down.
heatproof.shortDesc: Fire damage against this Pokemon is dealt with 1/2 offensive stat; 1/2 burn damage.

heatreservoir.name: Heat Reservoir
heatreservoir.desc: Flash Fire. After a boosted Armor Cannon deals damage, consumes the Flash Fire charge to prevent Armor Cannon's own Defense and Sp. Def drops. Retains Flash Fire's field effects.
heatreservoir.shortDesc: Flash Fire; a boosted Armor Cannon avoids its own defensive drops.

heavenlychorus.name: Heavenly Chorus
heavenlychorus.desc: This Pokemon has Pixilate, Cloud Nine, and Fluffy's effects.

heavyartillery.name: Heavy Artillery
heavyartillery.desc: Unaware + Shell Armor. Damaging pulse and bullet moves have double power and hit all foes in Doubles and Free-for-All. In Free-for-All, the designated primary target takes full damage and other foes take half their otherwise-calculated damage; protection or immunity of the primary does not promote another target. If no valid primary is supplied, the first active foe in side order is selected. Defense and Special Defense fall by 1 after firing.
heavyartillery.shortDesc: Unaware + Shell Armor. Double pulse/bullet power; spread. FFA primary full, others half; -1 Def/SpD after firing.

helios.name: Helios
helios.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons harsh sunlight. Its moves ignore opposing Abilities. Berserk raises its Special Attack by one stage when an attack leaves it at half HP or less, and by two stages on entry in Dragon's Den. Swift Swim doubles its Speed in rain, Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater, or Midnight Zone.
helios.shortDesc: Drought + Mold Breaker + Berserk + Swift Swim.

hellfireeclipse.name: Hellfire Eclipse
hellfireeclipse.desc: This Pokemon has Flash Fire and Dark Aura's effects. During harsh sunlight, its Attack and Special Attack are multiplied by 1.5. After it uses a Fire-type move, it sets Sunny Day for 2 turns.
hellfireeclipse.shortDesc: Solar Power + Dark Aura. Flash Fire + Dark Aura; Sun: Atk/SpA 1.5x; Fire moves set 2-turn Sun.

herdshelter.name: Herd Shelter
herdshelter.desc: Soundproof. Adjacent allies are also immune to opposing damaging sound moves.
herdshelter.shortDesc: Soundproof. Adjacent allies are also immune to opposing damaging sound moves.

hexbound.name: Hex Bound
hexbound.desc: Prankster + Cursed Body. Once per switch-in, a directly selected damaging Ghost move that removes HP from a surviving opponent traps that opponent through the following turn. Later hits do not refresh the trap; it ends when this Pokemon leaves. Ghost types, Shed Shell and normal pivot escapes still work. Misses, protection, substitutes, spread, called, future and residual damage do not trigger the trap. Cursed Body can disable incoming attacks (guaranteed on Haunted Field, disabled on Holy Field) and curses all foes when this Pokemon faints. No Shadow Tag trapping, damage reduction or item reveal.
hexbound.shortDesc: Prankster + Cursed Body; once per entry, a Ghost HP hit traps one foe through next turn.

highnoon.name: High Noon
highnoon.desc: Proficient + Dual Wield + Mega Launcher. Pulse and bullet moves gain Mega Launcher power; damaging moves never miss.

hisuianoath.name: Hisuian Oath
hisuianoath.desc: This Pokemon has Sworn Duty, Tough Claws, and Corrosion's effects.

hisuianpath.name: Hisuian Path
hisuianpath.desc: This Pokemon has Sap Sipper, Inner Focus, and Fluffy's effects.

hisuianresolve.name: Hisuian Resolve
hisuianresolve.desc: This Pokemon has Brute Force and Magma Armor's effects.
hisuianresolve.shortDesc: Brute Force + Reckless + Rock Head + Magma Armor.

hisuianvanguard.name: Hisuian Vanguard
hisuianvanguard.desc: This Pokemon has Rapid Response and Wind Power's effects.

holycow.name: Holy Cow
holycow.desc: On its first entry each battle, this Pokemon attempts to create Holy Field for 5 turns; it cannot refresh an existing Holy Field or bypass a protected field. Once per actual entry, Milk Drink that restores HP also cures this Pokemon's status. Ability changes do not reset this cure.
holycow.shortDesc: First entry: Holy Field for 5 turns. Once per entry, healing Milk Drink cures status.

hovercannon.name: Hover Cannon
hovercannon.desc: Levitate. Above half HP, damaging Electric moves cannot miss or be redirected. Type and ability immunities still apply.
hovercannon.shortDesc: Levitate; above half HP, Electric attacks cannot miss or be redirected.

hydraheart.name: Hydra Heart
hydraheart.desc: This Pokemon has Hydra Bond and Stamina's effects.

hydratyrant.name: Hydra Tyrant
hydratyrant.desc: Hydra Bond + Berserk. Once per battle, after Draco Meteor applies its Sp. Atk drops, restores all negative stat stages to zero after the entire attack finishes. Positive stages remain. No Self Sufficient healing or immunity.
hydratyrant.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Berserk; once per battle, Draco Meteor clears its negative stat stages.

hyperdrill.name: Hyper Drill
hyperdrill.desc: This Pokemon has Power Drill and Dual Wield's effects. Drill moves are used twice; the first hit receives Power Drill and the second hit deals 15% of the move's unboosted power. Its Rock-type moves receive a same-type attack bonus.
hyperdrill.shortDesc: Power Drill + Dual Wield; Rock moves get STAB.

iceface.name: Ice Face
iceface.desc: If this Pokemon is an Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its ice face is then broken and it changes forme to Noice Face. Eiscue regains its Ice Face forme when Snow begins or when Eiscue switches in while Snow is active. Confusion damage also breaks the ice face.
iceface.shortDesc: If Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes deals 0 damage. Effect is restored in Snow.

icemirror.name: Ice Mirror
icemirror.desc: Once per switch-in, the first opposing direct hit deals 25% less damage and lowers the attacker's Speed by 1 stage.
icemirror.shortDesc: First direct hit per entry deals 25% less damage and lowers the attacker’s Speed.

imperialmandate.name: Imperial Mandate
imperialmandate.desc: Outside boosted fields: at 50% HP or higher, attacks have 2x power; below 50%, Speed is doubled. On Fairy Tale, Chessboard, New World, Starlight Arena, and Cold Eclipse: at 50% HP or higher, grants +1 Defense and Special Defense with no attack boost; below 50%, removes its granted defense stages and grants 1.5x attack power and double Speed. Field defense stages do not stack and are removed on leaving these fields.
imperialmandate.shortDesc: High HP: 2x power outside boosted fields, or +1 Def/SpD on them; low HP: 2x Speed, plus 1.5x power on boosted fields.

imperialprincess.name: Imperial Princess
imperialprincess.desc: This Pokemon has Striker, Vital Spirit, and Moxie's effects, gains normal STAB on Fighting-type moves, and ignores the Fairy-type component of Poison- and Steel-type weaknesses.
imperialprincess.shortDesc: Striker + Vital Spirit + Moxie; Fighting STAB; ignores Fairy's Poison/Steel weakness.

intrepidsword.name: Intrepid Sword
intrepidsword.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.
intrepidsword.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.

irondominion.name: Iron Dominion
irondominion.desc: On switch-in or G-Max activation, this Pokemon activates Pressure and Mirror Armor's effects and heals its ally like Sworn Duty.

ironlash.name: Iron Lash
ironlash.desc: Whiplash. Gains +1 accuracy on entry and tail moves have 1.5x power. Once per turn, damaging a foe with a tail move also raises its Sp. Def by 1 stage.
ironlash.shortDesc: Whiplash; tail hits raise Sp. Def once per turn.

ironmountain.name: Iron Mountain
ironmountain.desc: This Pokemon has Filter, Stamina, and Heavy Metal's effects. Super-effective attacks deal 0.75x damage to it. Once per turn when hit by an opposing damaging move, its Defense rises by 1 stage and it restores 1/16 max HP. Its weight is doubled.

ironvise.name: Iron Vise
ironvise.desc: Tough Claws + Battle Armor + Light Metal + Intimidate. Strengthens contact moves, reduces incoming damage and prevents critical hits, lowers weight, and lowers foes' Attack on entry.
ironvise.shortDesc: Tough Claws + Battle Armor + Light Metal + Intimidate.

ironwill.name: Iron Will
ironwill.desc: Prism Armor + Second Wind + Self Sufficient + Whiplash. Raises Accuracy by one stage on entry and strengthens tail moves by 50%.
ironwill.shortDesc: Prism Armor + Second Wind + Self Sufficient + Whiplash.

islandcurrent.name: Island Current
islandcurrent.desc: This Pokemon has Swift Swim and Wind Rider's effects.

joyride.name: Joyride
joyride.desc: Aerilate + Violent Rush + Vital Spirit. On its first active turn, Speed rises 50% and Attack 20%; eligible Normal moves become Flying.

keenhunt.name: Keen Hunt
keenhunt.desc: Opponents cannot lower its Speed. Rock moves cannot miss and gain +1 critical-hit stage against targets at half HP or less.
keenhunt.shortDesc: Speed cannot be lowered by foes; Rock moves gain accuracy and crits vs. low-HP foes.

kickfiend.name: Kick Fiend
kickfiend.desc: This Pokemon has Striker, Violent Rush, and Limber's effects.

kindledfury.name: Kindled Fury
kindledfury.desc: Fluffy + Guts + Flash Fire. Fire attacks are absorbed, status strengthens physical attacks, and contact damage is reduced. Does not include Brute Force.

knuckletide.name: Knuckle Tide
knuckletide.desc: Has Iron Fist's full effect: punching moves have 1.4x power. After a punch damages a foe, the next physical or special Water-type attack to damage a foe ignores positive Defense or Sp. Def stat stages, respectively. A miss or Water-type status move does not spend the charge.
knuckletide.shortDesc: Iron Fist; a landed punch primes the next landed Water attack to ignore positive defensive boosts.

lanceguard.name: Lanceguard
lanceguard.desc: Shell Armor, including this server's damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects. Blocking a contact move with Protect lowers the attacker's Defense by 1 stage.
lanceguard.shortDesc: Shell Armor; blocking contact with Protect lowers the attacker's Defense.

lancepoint.name: Lance Point
lancepoint.desc: Has Keen Eye's full effect: opponents cannot lower its accuracy and its moves ignore the target's evasion boosts. On Mirror Arena, gains one accuracy stage and Laser Focus on entry. Drill moves gain one critical-hit stage and do not make contact. Critical-hit prevention still applies. Does not include Sniper.
lancepoint.shortDesc: Keen Eye; drill moves gain +1 critical-hit stage and do not make contact.

lastbrood.name: Last Brood
lastbrood.desc: Swarm. Once per battle, surviving an opposing hit that crosses from above half HP to half or less creates a Substitute with 1/8 maximum HP, at no HP cost. Cannot replace an existing Substitute.
lastbrood.shortDesc: Swarm; once per battle, crossing half HP creates a 1/8-HP Substitute.

layeredcoat.name: Layered Coat
layeredcoat.desc: This Pokemon has Fur Coat and Overcoat's effects.

layeredshell.name: Layered Shell
layeredshell.desc: Shell Armor. Once per switch-in, its first opposing special hit deals a further 25% less damage. Includes this server's Shell Armor critical-hit immunity, 20% damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects.
layeredshell.shortDesc: Shell Armor; the first special hit each entry deals 25% less damage.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.
levitate.shortDesc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.

lifeguard.name: Life Guard
lifeguard.desc: Friend Guard + Sworn Duty + full Propeller Tail. In Free-for-All only, successfully blocking an opposing damaging move with a protection move earns a guard that reduces the next opposing damaging hit by 25%, through the end of the following turn. It does not stack or refresh while active, is consumed by only one hit, and clears on switching. Merely using protection, blocking status moves or residual damage does not earn or consume it.
lifeguard.shortDesc: Friend Guard + Sworn Duty + Propeller Tail; FFA successful protection earns one 25% guard.

lightningrod.name: Lightning Rod
lightningrod.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. It redirects single-target Electric moves within range to itself. On Electric Terrain, both stats rise by 1 stage on entry.
lightningrod.shortDesc: Draws Electric moves to raise Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; Electric immunity.

livenet.name: Live Net
livenet.desc: Unnerve. While active, Sticky Web placed by this Pokemon also deals 1/16 maximum HP of Electric damage to grounded entrants. Heavy-Duty Boots, hazard immunity and Electric immunity prevent the added damage.
livenet.shortDesc: Unnerve; its Sticky Web also chips grounded entrants with Electric damage.

livewire.name: Livewire
livewire.desc: Transistor + Volt Absorb + Quick Feet + Iron Barbs. Electric attacks heal this Pokemon instead of damaging it. Its Electric attacks are boosted, its Speed rises while statused or on Electric Terrain, and contact attackers lose HP.
livewire.shortDesc: Transistor + Volt Absorb + Quick Feet + Iron Barbs.

livinglegend.name: Living Legend
livinglegend.desc: This Pokemon has Flash Fire, Download, and Sheer Force. Hidden effect: Extreme Speed has 1.5x power.
livinglegend.shortDesc: Flash Fire + Download + Sheer Force; Extreme Speed 1.5x.

livingtangle.name: Living Tangle
livingtangle.desc: Tangling Hair + Stamina. Contact attackers lose 1 Speed stage. Opposing hits raise Defense once per turn and restore 1/16 maximum HP per hit, as this server's Stamina does.
livingtangle.shortDesc: Tangling Hair + Stamina; contact slows foes while opposing hits raise Defense and heal.

lockjaw.name: Lockjaw
lockjaw.desc: Strong Jaw. Biting hits inflict Torment on a surviving foe for 2 turns. Does not prevent switching.
lockjaw.shortDesc: Strong Jaw. Biting hits inflict Torment on a surviving foe for 2 turns. Does not prevent switching.

longreach.name: Long Reach
longreach.desc: Removes contact and raises critical-hit rate by one stage. Also raises Accuracy on entry and retains field bonuses. No triple critical-hit damage.
longreach.shortDesc: Super Luck. Removes contact and raises critical-hit rate by one stage.

loyalguard.name: Loyal Guard
loyalguard.desc: This Pokemon has Friend Guard, Guard Dog, and Intimidate's effects.

lunarorbit.name: Lunar Orbit
lunarorbit.desc: This Pokemon has Magic Bounce, Serene Grace, Triage, and Magic Guard. On switch-in or Mega Evolution, it sets Gravity for 5 turns and sinks Water Surface to Underwater, Underwater to Midnight Zone, or Corrosive Mist to Corrosive. These field changes do not occur on New World.
lunarorbit.shortDesc: Magic Bounce + Serene Grace + Triage + Magic Guard; sets Gravity and sinks fields.

malicewell.name: Malice Well
malicewell.desc: Full Flame Body: contact attackers have a 30% burn chance (60% on Volcanic Field); Cold Eclipse instead grants +1 Defense and Sp. Def on entry and disables contact burns. Once per actual entry, the first opposing damaging move that executes against this Pokemon grants +1 Sp. Atk after the entire move finishes if it remains active and survives, including Protect, misses and immunity. All hits and spread targets share one activation. Ally moves, self damage, residual damage and moves that never execute do not qualify. Ability changes or suppression do not reset usage. The activation is consumed even at +6; switching resets usage and normal stat stages, and Haze removes the boost without refreshing usage.
malicewell.shortDesc: Flame Body; first hostile damaging move per entry: +1 SpA after survival, even through Protect.

marshconduit.name: Marsh Conduit
marshconduit.desc: Has Water Absorb's full effect, including healing from Water moves and qualifying water fields. The first Water move it absorbs each switch-in also lowers each active foe's Speed by one stage.
marshconduit.shortDesc: Water Absorb; first absorbed Water move each switch-in lowers foes' Speed by 1.

masonsfist.name: Mason's Fist
masonsfist.desc: Has Iron Fist's full effect. When a punching move damages a foe, it removes Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Arenite Wall, and Atlantis Wall from that foe's side.
masonsfist.shortDesc: Iron Fist; punches that damage a foe break that side's screens.

mastercourse.name: Master Course
mastercourse.desc: Contrary. Once per turn, damaging a foe with a Water or Dragon attack gives an adjacent ally +1 critical-hit stage for its next damaging move. The charge does not stack and ends on switching out.
mastercourse.shortDesc: Contrary; Water or Dragon hits grant an adjacent ally +1 critical-hit stage.

mightyjaw.name: Mighty Jaw
mightyjaw.desc: This Pokemon has Strong Jaw and Intimidate's effects. On its first action after switching in, its biting moves have 2 higher priority.
mightyjaw.shortDesc: Proficient. Strong Jaw + Intimidate; biting moves gain +2 priority on first action.

mirechorus.name: Mire Chorus
mirechorus.desc: Has Liquid Voice and Poison Touch's effects. Each foe damaged by a noncontact sound move also has an independent 20% chance to be poisoned. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this added poison chance.
mirechorus.shortDesc: Liquid Voice + Poison Touch; noncontact sound hits have a 20% poison chance.

mirrorgreed.name: Mirror Greed
mirrorgreed.desc: This Pokemon has Magic Bounce, Analytic, and Filter's effects.

moonlightvigil.name: Moonlight Vigil
moonlightvigil.desc: Inner Focus + Pressure + Illuminate. Prevents flinching, drains extra PP, and ignores opposing evasion.

moonlitwings.name: Moonlit Wings
moonlitwings.desc: This Pokemon has Serene Grace and gains STAB on Fairy-type moves.

moonveil.name: Moon Veil
moonveil.desc: Pastel Veil + Misty Surge. On entry, sets Misty Terrain, or Misty Aura over a compatible existing field. This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned and are cured of poison when this Ability becomes active. Opposing Poison-type moves lower their user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. Retains Pastel Veil's field effects.

mossarmor.name: Moss Armor
mossarmor.desc: Levitate + Stamina + full Natural Cure. In addition, switching out heals 1/8 maximum HP only after a Grass attack dealt opposing HP damage on the current or immediately preceding turn, with no intervening action. Natural Cure still cures status and heals 1/3 maximum HP when it does so. No Regenerator.
mossarmor.shortDesc: Levitate + Stamina + Natural Cure; conditional 1/8 Grass-attack switch healing.

motordrive.name: Motor Drive
motordrive.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.
motordrive.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by an Electric move; Electric immunity.

mountainhunger.name: Mountain Hunger
mountainhunger.desc: Sap Sipper + Thick Fat + Early Bird. Absorbs Grass moves, takes less damage from Fire and Ice moves, and wakes from sleep faster.
mountainhunger.shortDesc: Sap Sipper + Thick Fat + Early Bird.

mountainrift.name: Mountain Rift
mountainrift.desc: Combines Shell Armor and Self Sufficient. It cannot be critically hit, takes 0.8x damage, gains 2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats, heals 1/16 maximum HP each turn, and ignores sandstorm and hail damage. On entry, it creates Mountain Field for 5 turns. Once at half HP or less, it starts Gravity and resets Mountain Field to 5 turns. Its four moves are always Earthquake, Sand Tomb, Mountain Gale, and Stone Edge. The first time it would faint, it instead revives at full HP as Torterra-Rift-Shatter, clearing its status, boosts, and volatile conditions.
mountainrift.shortDesc: Shell Armor + Self Sufficient; 5-turn Mountain; half HP: Gravity + Mountain reset; first faint: full reset into Shatter.

mourningcoat.name: Mourning Coat
mourningcoat.desc: Fluffy. After a teammate has fainted, Fluffy's extra Fire weakness is removed for the rest of battle; contact damage reduction remains.
mourningcoat.shortDesc: Fluffy; its extra Fire weakness ends after a teammate faints.

mourningsnow.name: Mourning Snow
mourningsnow.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Hail for 8 turns, and Aurora Veil used by this Pokemon lasts 8 turns. During Hail or Snow, it heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Its damaging moves of any type gain an additional 30% chance to inflict frostbite, preserving their existing effects; this does not require weather. It is immune to Hail damage. When another Pokemon faints, it restores 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 if the faint was caused by an Ice move, Hail, Snow, or Curse. When it faints, all opposing Pokemon become cursed. Damaging hits disable the attacker's move when possible.
mourningsnow.shortDesc: Snow Warning + Ice Body. 8-turn Hail/Veil; damaging moves add 30% frostbite; faint healing/curse; hit Disable.

mourningvessel.name: Mourning Vessel
mourningvessel.desc: This Pokemon has Prankster's and Magic Guard's effects. Its damaging moves deal 20% more damage for each fainted ally, up to 2x damage. At the end of each turn, it restores 5% of its max HP for each fainted opposing Pokemon, counting every opposing side in Free-For-All battles.
mourningvessel.shortDesc: Prankster + Magic Guard; fallen allies boost damage; foes fainted heal 5% each turn.

mudtemper.name: Mud Temper
mudtemper.desc: Battle Armor, including this server's critical-hit immunity, 20% damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects. Surviving an opposing Fire or Water hit raises Sp. Def by 1 stage once per turn.
mudtemper.shortDesc: Battle Armor; surviving a Fire or Water hit raises Sp. Def once per turn.

mythicscale.name: Mythic Scale
mythicscale.desc: Marvel Scale + Levitate + Compound Eyes + Shield Dust, including their field effects. Once per switch-in, directly using a powder move to successfully inflict a non-volatile status on an opponent raises Defense by 1. Called or reflected moves and G-Max Befuddle do not trigger this bonus.
mythicscale.shortDesc: Marvel Scale + Levitate + Compound Eyes + Shield Dust; first direct powder status gives +1 Def.

naturalrecovery.name: Natural Recovery
naturalrecovery.desc: This Pokemon has Natural Cure and Regenerator's effects.

neurotoxin.name: Neurotoxin
neurotoxin.desc: Hydra Bond + Shed Skin + Regenerator. Biting moves do not gain Strong Jaw power.

neutralization.name: Neutralization
neutralization.desc: Once per target per move, when this Pokemon directly hits an opposing Pokemon, the target's higher attacking stat is lowered by 1 stage. Spread hits do not trigger this effect. This does not affect other Neutralization users or Pokemon immune to stat drops. While active, base field changes are neutralized, but Auras can still be created and remain active; Trick Room, Magic Room, and Wonder Room are ended and cannot start; and Rainbow Field ends automatically. It also suppresses Royal Decree's stat reset, screen removal, and ongoing restrictions, including those granted by Empress and Royal Sun. Ice Spinner and Steel Roller still remove terrain normally.
neutralization.shortDesc: Hits lower the foe's higher offensive stat by 1; blocks base field changes, not Auras.

nighthunt.name: Night Hunt
nighthunt.desc: Strong Jaw + Infiltrator + Intimidate. Biting moves have 1.5x power. Moves bypass substitutes and opposing screens. Lowers adjacent foes' Attack on entry.

nightmarepulse.name: Nightmare Pulse
nightmarepulse.desc: Pendulum Swing + Cursed Body + Bad Dreams. On entry, sets Haunted Field for 5 turns if field rules allow. Retains sleep immunity, accurate moves, damage reduction, disabling attackers, and damage to sleeping foes. Does not bypass screens or Substitute.
nightmarepulse.shortDesc: Pendulum Swing + Cursed Body + Bad Dreams; 5-turn Haunted Field on entry.

noblearmor.name: Noble Armor
noblearmor.desc: This Pokemon has Prism Armor and Ice Body's effects.

nobleconduit.name: Noble Conduit
nobleconduit.desc: This Pokemon has Battery, Solar Power, and Aftermath's effects.

nobledance.name: Noble Dance
nobledance.desc: This Pokemon has Dancer, Hospitality, and Own Tempo's effects.

noblerider.name: Noble Rider
noblerider.desc: This Pokemon has Swift Swim and Mold Breaker's effects.

noseformation.name: Nose Formation
noseformation.desc: This Pokemon has Filter and Elevate. After it hits, three 20 BP special Mini-Noses each select the strongest of Steel, Electric, or Rock against their current target. They chain to another valid foe after a KO, and their KOs trigger Elevate.
noseformation.shortDesc: Filter + Elevate; three adaptive 20 BP Mini-Noses chain after KOs and trigger Elevate.

oceanicwings.name: Oceanic Wings
oceanicwings.desc: This Pokemon has Water Absorb, Hydration, and Friend Guard's effects.

omenedge.name: Omen Edge
omenedge.desc: Sharpness + Dual Wield + Pressure; physical Doom Desire on faint. Slicing moves are strengthened. Contact moves no longer gain a separate bonus.
omenedge.shortDesc: Sharpness + Dual Wield + Pressure; physical Doom Desire on faint.

oneiricdust.name: Oneiric Dust
oneiricdust.desc: Psychic Surge. Once per switch-in, its first powder move that successfully hits a foe also lowers that foe's Sp. Def by 1 stage. Misses, immunity and protection do not spend the effect.
oneiricdust.shortDesc: Psychic Surge; the first landed powder move each entry lowers Sp. Def.

openingoverture.name: Opening Overture
openingoverture.desc: Once per switch-in, successfully using a sound move starts Tailwind for 3 turns. An existing longer Tailwind is not shortened.
openingoverture.shortDesc: Once per entry, a successful sound move starts 3-turn Tailwind.

opensky.name: Open Sky
opensky.desc: While itemless, immune to entry-hazard damage, Toxic Spikes poison and Sticky Web Speed drops; Flying moves do not make contact.
opensky.shortDesc: While itemless: immune to entry hazards; Flying moves make no contact.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.desc: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
opportunist.shortDesc: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

orchardbond.name: Orchard Bond
orchardbond.desc: This Pokemon has Hydra Bond and Harvest's effects.

palmmastery.name: Palm Mastery
palmmastery.desc: Thick Fat. Force Palm always inflicts paralysis when it lands, subject to status immunities. Its paralysis becomes a primary effect rather than a secondary roll.
palmmastery.shortDesc: Thick Fat; Force Palm always paralyzes when it lands.

paradoxpower.name: Paradox Power
paradoxpower.desc: This Pokemon has Sheer Force's effect and gains STAB on Electric-type moves.

parasitism.name: Parasitism
parasitism.desc: This Pokemon has Dry Skin. While above 50% HP, its weaknesses are neutralized, Magic Guard is active, opposing status moves fail, and opposing attack secondary effects are blocked. The first time Parasect would faint, it fake-faints at 1 HP, then becomes Parasect-Parasite at the end of the turn and revives at full HP. This Ability cannot be suppressed and is immune to Neutralization.
parasitism.shortDesc: Dry Skin; above half: defensive protection; first KO triggers Resuscitation.

patternshift.name: Pattern Shift
patternshift.desc: This Pokemon has Protean, Shed Skin, and Unaware's effects.

pearlcurrent.name: Pearl Current
pearlcurrent.desc: Has Water Absorb's full effect, including its water-field healing. The first Water-type move absorbed each switch-in also heals its lowest-HP active ally by 1/8 of that ally's maximum HP.
pearlcurrent.shortDesc: Water Absorb; first absorbed Water move each switch-in heals an ally by 1/8.

pendulumswing.name: Pendulum Swing
pendulumswing.desc: This Pokemon has Insomnia and Filter's effects. Its moves cannot miss.

peppersting.name: Pepper Sting
peppersting.desc: Insomnia. After using a Fire move, its first Grass attack to damage a foe each switch-in lowers that foe's Speed and Sp. Def by 1 stage. Retains this server's full Insomnia effects.
peppersting.shortDesc: Insomnia; a Fire move primes the next Grass hit to lower Speed and Sp. Def.

perfectego.name: Perfect Ego
perfectego.desc: This Pokemon has Ultra Ego's effects, and its moves cannot miss.

perfectforesight.name: Perfect Foresight
perfectforesight.desc: Includes Insomnia and retains its opposing-ability copying. Automatically applies target-specific Miracle Eye before a direct damaging Psychic move. Direct single-target HP damage stores a 90 BP Psychic special attack; opposing special HP damage stores a 90 BP special attack of the incoming type. Shares one pending attack per opposing trainer (one in singles, up to three in Free-for-All), released one per turn beginning next turn. Snapshots its own level, Special Attack, stages and typing, without copied offensive abilities or items. Queues survive switching/fainting and coexist with ordinary Future Sight; normal live defenses apply. Once per battle when Alakazam Mega Evolves, sets real Reflect and Light Screen for 5 turns without shortening longer screens.
perfectforesight.shortDesc: Trace + Insomnia. Insomnia + ability copy; Miracle Eye; stored attacks; once-per-battle Mega screens.

perfectstriker.name: Perfect Striker
perfectstriker.desc: This Pokemon has Striker, No Guard, and Libero's effects.

perishbody.name: Perish Body
perishbody.desc: If an enemy hits this Pokemon with a damaging move, all opposing Pokemon get Perish Song. If an affected opposing Pokemon already has Perish Song, its countdown is reduced by 1 instead. During Haunted Field, affected foes are trapped while adjacent to this Pokemon. This effect is blocked by Holy Field and does not trigger from allies.
perishbody.shortDesc: Enemy hit: foes get Perish Song; repeat hits lower the count; Haunted traps.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.desc: Ice Body + Ice Scales + Refrigerate. Contact attackers may be frozen. Hail, snow, and icy fields restore HP; special attacks deal half damage. Eligible Normal moves become Ice and gain power. Retains the component abilities' field effects.

phalanxform.name: Phalanx Form
phalanxform.desc: This Pokemon has Hydra Bond, Friend Guard, and Battle Armor's effects, gains STAB on Steel moves, and cannot be trapped.
phalanxform.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Friend Guard + Battle Armor; Steel STAB; untrappable.

phantombarrage.name: Phantom Barrage
phantombarrage.desc: This Pokemon has Infiltrator, Levitate, and Hydra Bond's effects. Dragon Darts and G-Max Spirit Volley use its higher offensive stat and gain 20% power from Hydra Bond instead of extra hits. Dragon Darts keeps its two-hit pattern; Spirit Volley keeps its full-power hit and weaker follow-up against another foe. In Free-for-All battles, Dragon Darts hits all opposing Pokemon twice.
phantombarrage.shortDesc: Clear Body + Infiltrator + Levitate + Hydra Bond. Infiltrator + Levitate + Hydra Bond; signature moves gain 20% power.

phantomfist.name: Phantom Fist
phantomfist.desc: Unseen Fist + Self Repair + Shadow Shield + Aftermath. Its moves cannot miss, contact moves bypass Protect, it repairs itself, takes less damage at full HP, and damages contact attackers that knock it out.
phantomfist.shortDesc: Unseen Fist + Self Repair + Shadow Shield + Aftermath; moves cannot miss.

pincercrush.name: Pincer Crush
pincercrush.desc: Tough Claws. Once per switch-in, its first Steel-type contact attack to damage a foe lowers the foe's Defense by 1 stage.
pincercrush.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first Steel contact hit per entry lowers the foe’s Defense.

plasmaeruption.name: Plasma Eruption
plasmaeruption.desc: Proficient boosts same-type attacks by 1.3x. Contact attackers have Static's chance to be paralyzed and Flame Body's chance to be burned. Fire moves may become Electric, and Electric moves may become Fire (50% chance each), unless the new type would make the target immune. After Burn Up removes Fire typing, Fire moves always become Electric; after Double Shock removes Electric typing, Electric moves always become Fire. Burn Up and Double Shock themselves keep their original type.
plasmaeruption.shortDesc: Proficient + Static + Flame Body; Fire may turn Electric or vice versa (50%). Type loss forces it unless immune.

pollenbloom.name: Pollen Bloom
pollenbloom.desc: This Pokemon has Thick Fat and Unaware's effects.
