At the end of each turn, opposing non-Grass Pokemon take Grass-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Grass immunities; this Pokemon heals the damage dealt by that chip. Only in Free-for-All does Grass type effectiveness scale this chip.
pollenbloom.shortDesc: Proficient + Thick Fat. Thick Fat + Unaware; healing Grass chip scales by type in FFA.

pollenengine.name: Pollen Engine
pollenengine.desc: Chlorophyll. Once per turn, successfully hitting a foe with a powder move or damaging Grass move heals itself and adjacent allies by 1/16 maximum HP, or 1/8 in sunlight.
pollenengine.shortDesc: Chlorophyll; Grass or powder hits heal it and its allies, more in sun.

primalego.name: Primal Ego
primalego.desc: This Pokemon has Unaware, Proficient, and Ultra Ego's effects. Ultra Ego's combat effects are inactive on Bewitched Woods, Haunted, and Holy Field.
primalego.shortDesc: Unaware + Proficient + Ultra Ego + Mold Breaker.

prismscale.name: Prism Scale
prismscale.desc: Marvel Scale boosts Defense while statused or on supported fields. Oblivious blocks Attract, Captivate, Taunt, and Intimidate's Attack drop. Swift Swim boosts Speed in rain and supported water fields.

prismwings.name: Prism Wings
prismwings.desc: Tinted Lens. Once per switch-in, damaging a foe with a resisted attack raises this Pokemon's Speed by 1 stage.
prismwings.shortDesc: Tinted Lens. Once per switch-in, damaging a foe with a resisted attack raises its Speed by 1 stage.

protectiveward.name: Protective Ward
protectiveward.desc: This Pokemon has Liquid Voice, Shell Armor, and Water Absorb's effects. It can use Arenite Wall and Aurora Veil regardless of weather or field.
protectiveward.shortDesc: Liquid Voice + Shell Armor + Water Absorb; ignores wall conditions.

pulseblockade.name: Pulse Blockade
pulseblockade.desc: On entry, sets Snowy Mountain Field for 5 turns. While active and effective, prevents other fields from being created or replacing the current field. Auras, natural field expiry, and restoration of an underlying field still work.
pulseblockade.shortDesc: 5-turn Snowy Mountain on entry; blocks other field creation while effective.

pulsebulwark.name: Pulse Bulwark
pulsebulwark.desc: On entry, sets Short-Circuit Field for 5 turns. Reflect and Light Screen gain +1 priority. Once per actual entry, successfully creating a new one of these screens cures major status on this Pokemon and its active allies. Ability changes do not reset the cure. Screens retain their normal duration, removal, and bypass rules.
pulsebulwark.shortDesc: 5-turn Short-Circuit; +1-priority screens; first new screen per entry cures active allies' status.

pulseeruption.name: Pulse Eruption
pulseeruption.desc: Full Sturdy: OHKO moves fail, and direct move damage cannot KO this Pokemon from full HP. On entry, attempts to create or refresh Super-Heated Terrain for 5 turns, respecting normal field restrictions. Once per battle, cures its major status and confusion when afflicted, including an existing affliction on entry. Suppression delays this cure without consuming it. Switching or ability changes do not refresh the cure. Skill Swap fails. At Camerupt-Pulse's fixed 1 HP, Sturdy can prevent repeated direct hits; indirect damage and ability bypass remain effective.
pulseeruption.shortDesc: Sturdy; 5-turn Super-Heated field on entry; one major-status/confusion cure per battle; no Skill Swap.

pulsetriad.name: Pulse Triad
pulsetriad.desc: Hydra Bond + Levitate + Clear Body. On entry, sets Factory Field for 5 turns. Eligible single-target attacks hit three times, it is ungrounded, and opponents cannot lower its stats.
pulsetriad.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Levitate + Clear Body; 5-turn Factory Field on entry.

pulsewaste.name: Pulse Waste
pulsewaste.desc: This Pokemon has Protean, Poison Touch, and Regenerator's effects.

punchfiend.name: Punch Fiend
punchfiend.desc: This Pokemon has Iron Fist, Inner Focus, and Unseen Fist's effects.
punchfiend.shortDesc: Iron Fist + Inner Focus + Unseen Fist.

quarrycannon.name: Quarry Cannon
quarrycannon.desc: Solid Rock, including this server's 20% damage reduction and additional 25% reduction against super-effective hits. Rock Blast always hits five times unless interrupted. Does not alter Z/Max moves or Rock Wrecker recharge rules.
quarrycannon.shortDesc: Solid Rock; Rock Blast always hits five times.

queensguard.name: Queen's Guard
queensguard.desc: This Pokemon has Contrary, Shed Skin, Intimidate, Infiltrator, and Proficient's effects. Its stat changes are reversed, it lowers opposing Attack on entry, and Shed Skin can clear ailments and restore HP. Its moves bypass substitutes and opposing screens, and attacks matching its type have 1.3x power.
queensguard.shortDesc: Contrary + Shed Skin + Intimidate + Infiltrator + Proficient.

quillreservoir.name: Quill Reservoir
quillreservoir.desc: Water Absorb, including its field effects. Absorbing a Water move primes its next landed damaging Poison move to poison the target. The charge does not stack; normal status immunities apply.
quillreservoir.shortDesc: Water Absorb; the next Poison hit after absorbing Water poisons its foe.

ragingbeast.name: Raging Beast
ragingbeast.desc: This Pokemon has Guts and Mold Breaker's effects.

ragingcurrent.name: Raging Current
ragingcurrent.desc: Swift Swim + Damp + Dry Skin + Stamina + Proficient. Water Veil and its burn immunity are removed.
ragingcurrent.shortDesc: Swift Swim + Damp + Dry Skin + Stamina + Proficient.

ragingfists.name: Raging Fists
ragingfists.desc: Hydra Bond, Normal/Fighting Ghost-immunity bypass, and damaging moves cannot miss. Retains Hydra Bond's Free-for-All targeting and Dragon's Den power bonus, without an extra multi-hit power multiplier. Does not grant Fighting Fiend's sleep immunity or Multiscale, or Scrappy's Intimidate immunity. Status moves retain their normal accuracy.
ragingfists.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Scrappy. Hydra Bond; Normal/Fighting hits Ghosts; damaging moves cannot miss.

ragingoverlord.name: Raging Overlord
ragingoverlord.desc: This Ability cannot be suppressed. This Pokemon has Raging Storm and Supreme Overlord's effects.
ragingoverlord.shortDesc: Raging Storm + Supreme Overlord + Mold Breaker + Battle Armor.

ragingstorm.name: Raging Storm
ragingstorm.desc: This Ability cannot be suppressed. This Pokemon has Mold Breaker and Battle Armor. Its attacks ignore Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, and defensive stat boosts. If this Pokemon gets a KO, it damages remaining foes for 60% of the last damage in multi battles, or raises Attack by 1 if there is no valid target or no damage is dealt. Magic Guard users do not take this damage.
ragingstorm.shortDesc: Cannot be suppressed; Mold Breaker + Battle Armor; attacks ignore screens/defensive boosts; KO bonus.

railguncircuit.name: Railgun Circuit
railguncircuit.desc: Lightning Rod; never misses; boosts Electric attacks. Redirects and absorbs Electric moves, raising Attack and Special Attack. Electric moves are strengthened; Ground damage is reduced on Electric Terrain.
railguncircuit.shortDesc: Lightning Rod; never misses; boosts Electric attacks.

railsight.name: Rail Sight
railsight.desc: Stalwart. Once per switch-in, a successful attack against a foe using Follow Me, Rage Powder, Lightning Rod or Storm Drain ignores damage-reducing screens. Does not bypass Substitute.
railsight.shortDesc: Stalwart; first hit through redirection each entry ignores screens.

rainsovereign.name: Rain Sovereign
rainsovereign.desc: On entry, this Pokemon sets Rain for 8 turns. Its Electric-, Water-, and Flying-type moves receive STAB. Each turn, non-immune foes take Water damage equal to 1/16 max HP. Only in Free-for-All does Water type effectiveness scale this chip.
rainsovereign.shortDesc: Drizzle. 8-turn Rain; Electric/Water/Flying STAB; Water chip scales by type in FFA.

razorcurrent.name: Razor Current
razorcurrent.desc: Drizzle + Strong Jaw + Speed Boost. Summons rain, strengthens biting moves, and raises Speed each turn. Steelworker is removed.

reapersgrip.name: Reaper's Grip
reapersgrip.desc: Unaware + Dark Aura + Self Sufficient; creates Haunted Field. Iron Fist no longer strengthens punching moves.
reapersgrip.shortDesc: Unaware + Dark Aura + Self Sufficient; creates Haunted Field.

rebornflower.name: Reborn Flower
rebornflower.desc: This Pokemon has Invigorate and Flower Veil's effects. It permanently becomes Florges-Reborn when it enters battle.
rebornflower.shortDesc: Invigorate + Flower Veil; permanently becomes Florges-Reborn on entry.

rechargerelay.name: Recharge Relay
rechargerelay.desc: Battery, including its existing Electric Terrain effect. Switching with Volt Switch restores 1/8 of the incoming teammate's maximum HP.
rechargerelay.shortDesc: Battery, including its existing Electric Terrain effect. Switching with Volt Switch restores 1/8 of the incoming teammate's HP.

relentlesshunt.name: Relentless Hunt
relentlesshunt.desc: This Pokemon has Levitate. Its moves with 60 or less Base Power gain +1 priority. In Fairy Tale, Big Top, Dragon's Den, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, or Cold Eclipse, its damaging moves deal 2x damage. In Desert, Rocky, Forest, Burning, Superheated, Ashen Beach, Water Surface, Cave, Starlight Arena, or New World, its damaging moves deal 1.5x damage.
relentlesshunt.shortDesc: Levitate; moves <=60 BP gain +1 priority; boosted fields give 1.5x or 2x damage.

relentlesslink.name: Relentless Link
relentlesslink.desc: Skill Link + Mold Breaker + Power Drill. Drill and horn moves gain Power Drill effects. Guts and Battle Armor are removed.
relentlesslink.shortDesc: Skill Link + Mold Breaker + Power Drill.

relicmishap.name: Relic Mishap
relicmishap.desc: This Pokemon takes 0.9x damage from attacks and has Self Sufficient, Water Absorb, and Volt Absorb. It restores 1/16 max HP each turn and is immune to Sandstorm and Hail damage. During Sandstorm, its Special Defense is multiplied by 1.5. During Hail or Snow, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
relicmishap.shortDesc: 0.9x damage; Self Sufficient; Water/Volt Absorb; Sand +SpD; Hail/Snow +Def.

requiem.name: Requiem
requiem.desc: This Pokemon has Cursed Body's effect. Its first direct damaging interaction with each opposing Pokemon applies Perish Song to that foe. The mark clears when the foe switches out. Whenever an opposing Pokemon faints, this Pokemon restores 1/4 max HP. When this Pokemon faints, it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns. This Ability cannot be suppressed.
requiem.shortDesc: Cursed Body; first hit marks foes with Perish Song; foe KO heals 1/4; faint sets Haunted.

reservoir.name: Reservoir
reservoir.desc: Has Water Absorb, Gluttony, and Damp's full effects. Water-type moves from other Pokemon heal 1/4 maximum HP instead of hitting; qualifying water fields heal 1/16 each turn. Berries normally eaten at 1/4 HP activate at 1/2 HP. Prevents Explosion, Self-Destruct, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, and Aftermath damage. Halves the attacking stat used by incoming Fire-type moves, and prevents Damp's ignition moves on Corrosive Mist Field.

resonantblade.name: Resonant Blade
resonantblade.desc: Slicing moves ignore damage reduction from Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Atlantis Wall and Arenite Wall. Does not bypass Substitute.
resonantblade.shortDesc: Slicing moves bypass screens and walls, but not Substitute.

resuscitation.name: Resuscitation
resuscitation.desc: When Parasect revives as Parasect-Parasite, its status, stat stages, and volatile effects are cleared and it returns to full HP. Afterward, this Ability has Self Repair and Magic Guard's effects.
resuscitation.shortDesc: Revival fully resets battle effects; Self Repair + Magic Guard.

riftdancer.name: Rift Dancer
riftdancer.desc: Chlorophyll + Dancer. Once per battle, its first successful activation creates a full Stage 1 Flower Garden for 5 turns, respecting protected fields. Existing gardens are not advanced or refreshed, and failed creation does not spend the use. Each actual stage gained adds 1 remaining turn to this garden, including re-growth; lowering a stage or trying to grow at maximum adds nothing. The garden keeps this property after the user switches out.
riftdancer.shortDesc: Chlorophyll + Dancer; once/battle 5-turn full Garden; +1 turn per stage gained.

rifteater.name: Rift Eater
rifteater.desc: Combines Accumulation and Sand Stream. Its fourth move is always Sludge Wave. At half HP or less, it creates Desert Field, becomes Ground/Fire, and changes its fourth move to Heat Wave. If sandstorm has ended, it summons it again at that moment.
rifteater.shortDesc: Accumulation + Sand Stream; at half HP: Desert Field, Ground/Fire, Sludge Wave becomes Heat Wave, restores sand.

rimeclaw.name: Rime Claw
rimeclaw.desc: Tough Claws. The first Ice-type contact attack to damage a foe each switch-in removes one opposing screen after damage.
rimeclaw.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first Ice contact hit per entry breaks a screen.

rimeknuckle.name: Rime Knuckle
rimeknuckle.desc: Filter + Iron Fist + Ice Body. Damaging moves have a 40% chance to cause frostbite (80% on Icy Field). KOs restore 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 against Mega, G-Max, Terastallized, Stellar or Z-Move item targets. Ice Body adds a 30% chance to frostbite contact attackers, hail immunity, and healing in hail/snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse fields. Healing is 1/16 max HP, or 1/8 in hail on Cold Eclipse.
rimeknuckle.shortDesc: Filter + Iron Fist + Ice Body; frostbite chance; KO healing.

ringmaster.name: Ringmaster
ringmaster.desc: Tough Claws. Its first damaging Dark hit against a surviving foe each entry attempts to inflict Taunt for 2 turns. Normal Taunt immunities apply; no Fake Out requirement.
ringmaster.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first Dark hit each entry Taunts the foe for 2 turns.

riotamp.name: Riot Amp
riotamp.desc: This Pokemon has Galvanize, Resonance Force, and Volt Absorb's effects.

riptideclaws.name: Riptide Claws
riptideclaws.desc: This Pokemon has Swift Swim, Tough Claws, Shell Armor, and Mold Breaker's effects.
riptideclaws.shortDesc: Swift Swim + Tough Claws + Shell Armor + Mold Breaker.

rivershell.name: River Shell
rivershell.desc: Shell Armor, including this server's damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects. Shell Smash does not lower its Defense, but still lowers its Sp. Def.
rivershell.shortDesc: Shell Armor; Shell Smash keeps Defense but still lowers Sp. Def.

rootediron.name: Rooted Iron
rootediron.desc: Stamina. At the end of turns in which this Pokemon did not attempt a damaging move, it restores 1/16 maximum HP. Also retains this server's Stamina on-hit Defense gain and healing.
rootediron.shortDesc: Stamina; heals 1/16 HP on turns when it does not attack.

rootrenewal.name: Root Renewal
rootrenewal.desc: Regenerator. Switching out restores 1/3 maximum HP and cures one adjacent active ally's major status condition.
rootrenewal.shortDesc: Regenerator. Switching out restores 1/3 HP and cures one adjacent active ally's major status condition.

royalarmament.name: Royal Armament
royalarmament.desc: This Pokemon gains STAB on Steel-type moves and has Power Drill's effects.

royaldecree.name: Royal Decree
royaldecree.desc: On switch-in, all active Pokemon's stat stages are reset to 0, except Pokemon on a side protected by Safeguard, and Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil are removed from both sides. While this Pokemon is active, Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil cannot be created, enemy stat boosts fail, enemy-caused stat drops fail, and charge moves fire immediately. This Pokemon's own self-inflicted stat drops still work. Neutralization disables these Royal Decree effects while active. If Neutralization is already active on entry, the stat and screen reset does not happen; it does not happen later when Neutralization leaves.
royaldecree.shortDesc: Haze/screen clear; Safeguard blocks reset; blocks setup/screens; skips charge turns.

royalscales.name: Royal Scales
royalscales.desc: Prism Scale, Dragonize, and Self Sufficient. Status or Prism Scale's supported fields boost Defense by 1.5x. Blocks Attract, Captivate, Taunt, and Intimidate's Attack drop. Speed doubles in rain and Swift Swim's supported fields. Normal moves become Dragon and gain Dragonize's power boost. Restores 1/16 of this Pokemon's maximum HP at the end of each turn and prevents Sandstorm and Hail damage.
royalscales.shortDesc: Prism Scale + Marvel Scale + Oblivious + Swift Swim + Dragonize + Self Sufficient. Prism Scale + Dragonize + Self Sufficient; heals 1/16 each turn; immune to Sandstorm and Hail.

royalsun.name: Royal Sun
royalsun.desc: Drought + Supreme Overlord. Summons sun on entry and gains Supreme Overlord's bonuses as allies faint.

royalvoice.name: Royal Voice
royalvoice.desc: Pixilate + Queenly Majesty + Dream Sickness. Normal moves become Fairy and receive Pixilate power boosts. Blocks opposing priority moves targeting its side. Includes Telepathy and its field effects, 1/16 end-turn healing for itself and allies, and a once-per-switch-in rescue that leaves an ally at 1 HP and costs the holder 1/4 max HP.
royalvoice.shortDesc: Pixilate + Queenly Majesty + Dream Sickness + Telepathy.

ruinjaw.name: Ruin Jaw
ruinjaw.desc: This Pokemon has Strong Jaw and Earth Eater's effects.

sacredbond.name: Sacred Bond
sacredbond.desc: Battle Bond's shared effects plus Magma Armor, Intimidate, and Flash Fire. Arcanine-Battle-Bond's Extreme Speed has 1.5x power and always critically hits.
sacredbond.shortDesc: Battle Bond + Filter + Self Sufficient + Magma Armor + Intimidate + Flash Fire. Battle Bond + Magma Armor + Intimidate + Flash Fire; Extreme Speed is 1.5x power and always critical.

sacrededge.name: Sacred Edge
sacrededge.desc: This Pokemon has Sharpness, Dual Wield, and Sworn Duty's effects. Its slicing moves have 1.5x power. When Dual Wield applies to one of those slicing moves, the first hit keeps the 1.5x Sharpness boost and the second hit has 20% of the move's unboosted power. On switch-in or Mega Evolution, it heals its ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale Field.

sacredpower.name: Sacred Power
sacredpower.desc: Duskilate + Insomnia + Magic Guard. Adaptability is removed.

safeharbor.name: Safe Harbor
safeharbor.desc: Ice Body + Water Absorb + Hydration. Absorbs Water attacks, heals under icy weather/fields, and cures status in rain or water fields. Ice attacks are not absorbed.

saltbastion.name: Salt Bastion
saltbastion.desc: Sturdy. When Sturdy saves this Pokemon from a direct hit, its side gains Safeguard for 5 turns.
saltbastion.shortDesc: Sturdy. When Sturdy saves it from a direct hit, its side gains Safeguard for 5 turns.

saltcrust.name: Salt Crust
saltcrust.desc: Clear Body. While Defense is positively boosted, opponents cannot remove its held item. Does not prevent its boosts being reset, stolen or ignored.
saltcrust.shortDesc: Clear Body; while Defense is boosted, its held item cannot be removed.

sandsovereign.name: Sand Sovereign
sandsovereign.desc: On entry, this Pokemon sets Sandstorm for 8 turns. It has Dauntless Shield and Solid Rock. Arenite Wall lasts 5 turns, or 8 turns when extended. Each turn, non-immune foes take Rock damage equal to 1/16 max HP. Only in Free-for-All does Rock type effectiveness scale this chip.
sandsovereign.shortDesc: Sand Stream + Dauntless Shield + Solid Rock. 8-turn Sand; Dauntless Shield + Solid Rock; Rock chip scales by type in FFA.

sandstream.name: Sand Stream
sandstream.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.
sandstream.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

sapsipper.name: Sap Sipper
sapsipper.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move. Grass moves from an ally also raise both stats. Grassy and Forest fields restore HP each turn.
sapsipper.shortDesc: Grass moves raise Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; Grass immunity.

savageresolve.name: Savage Resolve
savageresolve.desc: Full Guts: Attack is multiplied by 1.5 while statused, and burn does not halve physical damage. Once per actual entry, after surviving an entire opposing damaging move that dealt actual HP damage while this Pokemon was already statused, it gains one Speed stage if still active. Status inflicted after a hit does not make that hit qualify. All hits and opponents share one activation. Substitute-only, ally, self, residual and delayed damage do not qualify. Switching resets usage; ability replacement and suppression do not. Suppression disables the effect. The Speed boost is an ordinary stat stage and does not remove paralysis's Speed penalty.
savageresolve.shortDesc: Guts; once per entry, surviving a foe's HP-damaging attack while statused gives +1 Speed.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.desc: This Pokemon has Wind Rider, Steelworker, and Stakeout's effects.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.desc: This Pokemon has Overcoat, Big Pecks, and Regenerator's effects.

schooling.name: Schooling
schooling.desc: A level 20 or higher Wishiwashi changes to School Form above 1/4 maximum HP. Underwater and Midnight Zone force School Form; Water Surface and Murkwater force it while grounded. It returns to Solo Form at or below 1/4 maximum HP otherwise. While in School Form, it has Hydra Bond, Self Repair, and Mold Breaker's effects.
schooling.shortDesc: Changes form by HP and water terrain; School: Hydra Bond + Self Repair + Mold Breaker.

scorchsweep.name: Scorch Sweep
scorchsweep.desc: Once per switch-in, damaging a foe with a recoil move clears entry hazards from its side. The attack still deals normal recoil.
scorchsweep.shortDesc: Once per entry, recoil-move damage clears its side’s hazards.

seablessing.name: Sea Blessing
seablessing.desc: This Pokemon's Defense and Special Defense are 1.5x. On entry, it and adjacent allies heal 1/4 max HP, and it gains Aqua Ring. It has Water Veil and Rain Dish.
seablessing.shortDesc: 1.5x Def/SpD; entry heals self/allies 1/4; Water Veil + Rain Dish.

seafiend.name: Sea Fiend
seafiend.desc: This Pokemon has Toxic Debris and Water Bubble's effects.
seafiend.shortDesc: Toxic Debris + Water Bubble + Water Veil.

searescuer.name: Sea Rescuer
searescuer.desc: Once per entry, the first Roost that actually restores HP lets the trainer choose a replacement after healing, if one is available. Switching abilities does not refresh this effect.
searescuer.shortDesc: Once per entry, Roost healing lets it switch out.

seasonalstride.name: Seasonal Stride
seasonalstride.desc: Normal moves become this Pokemon's primary type and have 1.2x power. Kicking moves have 1.4x power. It has Chlorophyll and changes forme with weather: Spring in rain, Summer in sun, Autumn in sand, Winter in snow.
seasonalstride.shortDesc: Normal -> primary type 1.2x; kicks 1.4x; Chlorophyll; weather forms.

selfrepair.name: Self Repair
selfrepair.desc: This Pokemon has Self Sufficient and Natural Cure's effects.

serratedpincers.name: Serrated Pincers
serratedpincers.desc: This Pokemon's slicing moves deal 1.3x damage and do not make contact.
serratedpincers.shortDesc: Slicing moves deal 1.3x damage and do not make contact.

seviischooling.name: Sevii Schooling
seviischooling.desc: Changes Wishiwashi into its Ghost-type Sevii form, or Ghost/Dragon Sevii Schooling form at level 20 or higher above 1/4 maximum HP. Underwater and Midnight Zone force School Form; Water Surface and Murkwater force it while grounded. The School Form has Hydra Bond, Self Repair, and Mold Breaker's effects.
seviischooling.shortDesc: Schooling + Hydra Bond + Self Repair + Mold Breaker. Changes Wishiwashi to Sevii form; School: Hydra Bond + Self Repair + Mold Breaker.

shadowbond.name: Shadow Bond
shadowbond.desc: Battle Bond's shared effects plus Proficient and Infiltrator. Ash-Greninja's Water Shuriken hits three times at 30 base power per hit and always critically hits.
shadowbond.shortDesc: Battle Bond + Filter + Self Sufficient + Proficient + Infiltrator. Battle Bond + Proficient + Infiltrator; Water Shuriken is 3 hits at 30 power, always critical.

shadowcurrent.name: Shadow Current
shadowcurrent.desc: This Pokemon has Protean, Technician, Infiltrator, and Anticipation's effects. Before using a move, it becomes that move's type.

shadowguard.name: Shadow Guard
shadowguard.desc: Elevate + Shadow Shield + Temporal Shift + Insomnia. It is ungrounded, halves attack damage at full HP, cannot sleep or be affected by Yawn, and opposing Pokemon cannot lower its stats. On Dark Crystal Cavern, New World, Starlight Arena, or Cold Eclipse, super-effective attack damage is further reduced to 0.75x. Its Dark- and Ghost-type damaging moves have 1.3x power, and it raises its highest stat after a move KO. Starting on Mega Evolution, it queues a 120 BP Ghost-type Future Sight on that turn and every other turn afterward; each queued attack strikes two turns later. It does not trap foes or have Magic Guard's indirect-damage immunity.
shadowguard.shortDesc: Elevate + Shadow Shield + Temporal Shift + Insomnia; 120 BP Ghost Future Sight every other turn.

shieldsdown.name: Shields Down
shieldsdown.desc: If this Pokemon is a Minior, it changes to its Core forme if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, and changes to Meteor Form if it has more than 1/2 its maximum HP. This check is done on switch-in and at the end of each turn. While in its Meteor Form, it cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. This Pokemon also has Shell Armor, Self Repair, and Crumbling Shell's effects.
shieldsdown.shortDesc: Form changes at 1/2 HP; Shell Armor + Self Repair + Crumbling Shell.

siegelauncher.name: Siege Launcher
siegelauncher.desc: This Pokemon has Water Barrage, Mega Launcher, Self Sufficient, and Stalwart's effects. Moves boosted by Mega Launcher are used twice through Dual Wield; the second hit deals 15% of the move's unboosted power.
siegelauncher.shortDesc: Stalwart + Proficient. Water Barrage + Mega Launcher + Self Sufficient + Stalwart; boosted moves add 15% hit.

silkendecoy.name: Silken Decoy
silkendecoy.desc: Mega Ariados spins a persistent cocoon, renewed when another Pokemon faints. It blocks status moves and status conditions while intact, and absorbs one damaging move including all its hits and secondary effects. Also has Insomnia, Self Sufficient, and Swarm.
silkendecoy.shortDesc: Cocoon blocks a move, status and secondaries; Insomnia + Self Sufficient + Swarm.

silkshuriken.name: Silk Shuriken
silkshuriken.desc: Water Shuriken becomes Bug-type and hits exactly three times at 20 base power per hit, retaining its priority. Does not alter Z/Max moves.
silkshuriken.shortDesc: Water Shuriken becomes Bug-type: three hits, 20 power each. Priority unchanged.

silksights.name: Silk Sights
silksights.desc: Compound Eyes. Electric attacks ignore positive defensive stat stages against foes whose Speed is lowered.
silksights.shortDesc: Compound Eyes; Electric moves ignore defense boosts on foes with lowered Speed.

sirius.name: Sirius
sirius.desc: Apex Venom + Black Viper. Retains Apex Venom, Dragon-type Poison Fang, +1 accuracy on entry and 1.5x tail power. Its first tail hit against a foe each entry also badly poisons it, subject to status immunities.
sirius.shortDesc: Apex Venom + Black Viper + Whiplash. Apex Venom + Black Viper; first tail hit each entry badly poisons.

slipstream.name: Slipstream
slipstream.desc: Has Levitate's full effect. Once per switch-in, its first Flying-type attack to damage a foe sets Tailwind on its side for 3 turns. If Tailwind is already active, its duration is refreshed to 3 turns.
slipstream.shortDesc: Levitate; first landed Flying attack each switch-in sets 3-turn Tailwind.

slowclamp.name: Slow Clamp
slowclamp.desc: Shell Armor + Own Tempo + Analytic + Sweet Veil. Prevents critical hits and confusion, boosts attacks used after other active Pokemon move, and protects this Pokemon and allies from sleep.
slowclamp.shortDesc: Shell Armor + Own Tempo + Analytic + Sweet Veil.

smolderingshroud.name: Smoldering Shroud
smolderingshroud.desc: Has White Smoke's full effect: prevents stat drops from other Pokemon, and raises Attack and Sp. Atk on entry on Volcanic Field. The first foe-caused stat drop it prevents each switch-in also raises its Sp. Atk by one stage.
smolderingshroud.shortDesc: White Smoke; first blocked foe stat drop each switch-in raises Sp. Atk by 1.

snowpack.name: Snowpack
snowpack.desc: Thick Fat + Ice Body + Tough Claws. Includes reduced Fire/Ice damage, contact-move power, weather/field healing, and this server's Ice Body contact-freeze chance.
snowpack.shortDesc: Thick Fat + Ice Body + Tough Claws.

snowwarning.name: Snow Warning
snowwarning.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.
snowwarning.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

soaringspirit.name: Soaring Spirit
soaringspirit.desc: This Pokemon has Wind Power and Self Sufficient's effects.

solarhydra.name: Solar Hydra
solarhydra.desc: Hydra Bond + Grassy Surge + Solar Power + Solar Bud. Once per entry, finishing a turn in effective sun stores a bud; the next Grass attack dealing opposing HP damage consumes it to cure status and heal 1/8 maximum HP. Solar Power's HP cost and field effects remain. No Self Repair.
solarhydra.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Grassy Surge + Solar Power + one sun-charged Solar Bud per entry.

solarrush.name: Solar Rush
solarrush.desc: This Pokemon has Sand Rush and Chlorophyll's effects.

solartrap.name: Solar Trap
solartrap.desc: Accumulation + Digestive Sap + Liquid Ooze. Poison attacks heal 1/3 of actual damage dealt to foes, capped at 1/8 max HP per turn; draining moves used on this Pokemon hurt the user instead.

soothingpresence.name: Soothing Presence
soothingpresence.desc: Combines Friend Guard and Aroma Veil. Other allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not reduce the holder's damage taken. The holder and its allies are protected from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.
soothingpresence.shortDesc: Friend Guard + Aroma Veil. Other allies take 25% less attack damage. Holder and allies have Aroma Veil protection.

soulcremation.name: Soul Cremation
soulcremation.desc: Soul Siphon + Soul Pyre + Malice Well. Malice Well includes full Flame Body. Once per entry, the first executed opposing damaging move targeting this Pokemon grants +1 Sp. Atk after the entire move resolves if it is still active and alive, even through Protect, misses or immunity. Multihit and spread moves count only once. Ability changes and suppression do not reset the spent limit; a genuine switch-in does. The first activation is spent even at +6 Sp. Atk. The boost is an ordinary stat stage, removed by switching or Haze. Soul Siphon: direct Fire/Ghost attacks that deal actual HP damage to foes heal one-third of that damage, capped at one-sixth of the user's maximum HP per turn across all hits and targets. Surviving targets cannot heal through the following turn. Native draining moves get no extra siphon healing; delayed attacks, allies and Substitute damage do not count. Soul Pyre: after at least one foe actually takes burn damage that turn, heal 1/8 base maximum HP at turn end, once regardless of how many foes were burned (including FFA). This is separate from Soul Siphon's cap; prevented burn damage does not count. Once per turn across all hits and foes, a damaging Ghost hit against an already-burned surviving foe also attempts to lower its Sp. Def by 1. Flame Body: contact attackers have a 30% burn chance, 60% on Volcanic Field; Cold Eclipse instead gives +1 Defense and Sp. Def on entry and prevents these contact burns. Healing prevention on the holder still blocks both healing effects; ability suppression stops the component hooks. No trapping.
soulcremation.shortDesc: Soul Siphon + Soul Pyre + Malice Well; drain/burn healing; first hostile attack per entry: +1 SpA after survival.

soulsiphon.name: Soul Siphon
soulsiphon.desc: Direct Fire/Ghost damage to opponents heals one-third of actual HP damage, capped at one-sixth max HP per turn across all hits and targets. Also prevents the damaged target from recovering HP through the end of the following turn; switching clears this effect and repeated hits refresh it. Does not siphon from substitutes, allies, residual or future damage, or moves that already drain. Normal drain interactions apply.
soulsiphon.shortDesc: Fire/Ghost HP damage drains 1/3, capped at 1/6 HP/turn; briefly blocks healing.

soultag.name: Soul Tag
soultag.desc: Soul Fire + Shadow Tag + Flame Body. Traps adjacent foes, gains Soul Fire's Fire/Ghost effects, and can burn contact attackers.
soultag.shortDesc: Soul Fire + Shadow Tag + Flame Body.

spinfiend.name: Spin Fiend
spinfiend.desc: This Pokemon has Technician and Vital Spirit's effects.

spiralevolution.name: Spiral Evolution
spiralevolution.desc: This Pokemon has Adaptability, Levitate, Dual Wield, Infiltrator, and Shield Dust. Its damaging moves pierce protection for reduced damage, its normal-priority moves act first in Trick Room without gaining priority, it ignores field-based Speed penalties, and it takes 0.8x damage.
spiralevolution.shortDesc: Adaptability + Levitate + Dual Wield + Infiltrator + Shield Dust; ignores field Speed penalties; protection pierce; takes 0.8x.

springfur.name: Spring Fur
springfur.desc: Has Fur Coat's full effect, doubling Defense. Once per switch-in, surviving the first damaging physical move from a foe raises this Pokemon's Attack by one stage.
springfur.shortDesc: Fur Coat; first survived physical hit from a foe each switch-in raises Atk by 1.

stancechange.name: Stance Change
stancechange.desc: This Pokemon has Dual Wield. Aegislash changes to Blade Forme before attacking and Shield Forme before King's Shield. Shield Forme takes 20% less damage; consecutive Free-for-All hits deal 30% less damage. Blade Forme deals 1.2x damage. On Fairy Tale and Chessboard, activation raises Defense and Special Defense by 1; switching to Blade raises Attack and Special Attack by 1 and lowers both defenses by 1, with the reverse on switching to Shield.
stancechange.shortDesc: Dual Wield; Shield: 20% less damage; Blade: 1.2x damage.

steamengine.name: Steam Engine
steamengine.desc: This Pokemon has Magma Armor. Fire- or Water-type hits raise its Speed by 6 stages; heat fields activate it on entry, and Water Surface, Underwater, or Volcanic Terrain raises Speed each turn.
steamengine.shortDesc: Magma Armor; Fire/Water hits raise Speed by 6; certain fields also activate it.

stillwater.name: Stillwater
stillwater.desc: Water Absorb, including its field effects. Absorbing a Water move while already at full HP raises Sp. Def by 1 stage once per turn.
stillwater.shortDesc: Water Absorb; absorbing Water at full HP grants +1 Sp. Def once per turn.

stillwaters.name: Still Waters
stillwaters.desc: This Pokemon has Cloud Nine, Magic Guard, and Unaware's effects.

stonewall.name: Stonewall
stonewall.desc: Sturdy. When Sturdy saves this Pokemon from a direct hit, it sets one layer of Spikes on the opposing side.
stonewall.shortDesc: Sturdy. When Sturdy saves it from a direct hit, it sets one layer of Spikes on the opposing side.

stormbell.name: Storm Bell
stormbell.desc: Mirror Armor + Drizzle + Elevate. Starts rain, reflects opposing stat drops, reduces attack damage by 20%, is airborne, and boosts its best stat after a move KO. Retains Mirror Armor field effects, including +1 Defense and Sp. Def on Fairy Tale entry.

stormcalling.name: Storm Calling
stormcalling.desc: Drizzle + full Liquid Voice + Dissonant Echo. Sound moves become Water-type (Ice on Icy Field) and gain 1.2x power. Once per entry a resisted sound attack dealing opposing HP damage marks one foe; the next sound attack against it through next turn consumes the mark on attempt and ignores resistance, not immunity. Target switching clears the mark.
stormcalling.shortDesc: Drizzle + Liquid Voice + Dissonant Echo (one marked foe per entry).

stormcircuit.name: Storm Circuit
stormcircuit.desc: Electric Surge + Elevate + Current Coil. Summons the Electric aura, retains its existing KO highest-stat boost, and has Swift Swim plus Coil granting an additional +1 Sp. Atk.
stormcircuit.shortDesc: Electric Surge + Elevate + Current Coil + Swift Swim. Electric Surge + Current Coil; Coil also raises Sp. Atk, with Swift Swim.

stormdrain.name: Storm Drain
stormdrain.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and raises its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Water-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Water-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.
stormdrain.shortDesc: This Pokemon draws Water moves to itself to raise Atk and Sp. Atk by 1; Water immunity.

stormfright.name: Storm Fright
stormfright.desc: Intimidate + Storm Power + Lightning Rod. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1 stage. Draws in and absorbs Electric moves, raising Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage; Electric Terrain also grants these boosts on entry. In rain, Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5, but this Pokemon loses 1/8 of its maximum HP each turn.

stormsong.name: Storm Song
stormsong.desc: Liquid Voice + Drizzle + Soundproof. Summons rain, turns sound moves into Water moves, and blocks sound moves.

stormsovereign.name: Storm Sovereign
stormsovereign.desc: Sets changeable Strong Winds; Gale Wings + Keen Eye; moves never miss. Strong Winds lasts 8 turns and can be replaced by another weather. This ability does not summon Windy Aura.
stormsovereign.shortDesc: Sets changeable Strong Winds; Gale Wings + Keen Eye; moves never miss.

streettyrant.name: Street Tyrant
streettyrant.desc: This Pokemon has Intimidate, Shed Skin, and Mold Breaker's effects.

strikerfrenzy.name: Striker Frenzy
strikerfrenzy.desc: Striker + Vital Spirit. Kicking moves gain 1.4x power; this Pokemon cannot sleep or be affected by Yawn and gains Vital Spirit's field-dependent Attack boost.
strikerfrenzy.shortDesc: Striker + Vital Spirit; stronger kicks and sleep immunity.

strikersmomentum.name: Striker's Momentum
strikersmomentum.desc: This Pokemon has Striker, Defiant, and Libero's effects, and its moves cannot miss. Once per switch-in, a KO caused by this Pokemon raises its Speed by 1 stage.
strikersmomentum.shortDesc: Proficient. Moves cannot miss; Striker + Defiant + Libero; first KO gives +1 Speed.

suncharm.name: Sun Charm
suncharm.desc: Drought. Its first landed Fire hit each entry extends the sunlight it summoned by 1 turn, capped at 8 remaining turns. Once per entry, burning a foe also curses it: 1/8 maximum HP lost per turn under this server's ability-Curse rules. No HP cost to Ninetales.
suncharm.shortDesc: Drought; first Fire hit adds 1 sun turn (max 8); first burn also curses the foe.

sunsovereign.name: Sun Sovereign
sunsovereign.desc: This Pokemon has Drought, Unbound Blaze, and Self Sufficient's effects. Its sun lasts 8 turns.
sunsovereign.shortDesc: Drought + Unbound Blaze + Self Sufficient + Proficient. Drought + Unbound Blaze + Self Sufficient; 8-turn Sun.

supersweetsyrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweetsyrup.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of adjacent opposing Pokemon by 1 stage every time it switches in. This Pokemon has Sticky Hold. When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the attacker is Embargoed for 5 turns.
supersweetsyrup.shortDesc: On switch-in, lowers adjacent foes' evasiveness 1 stage; Sticky Hold; attackers are Embargoed for 5 turns.

supremeoverlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supremeoverlord.desc: Each fainted ally adds 10% move damage; in Free-for-All, allies count twice. At 2+ fallen allies it gains Infiltrator; 4+, flinch immunity from Inner Focus; 5+, indirect-damage immunity and a one-time +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. It does not block stat drops.
supremeoverlord.shortDesc: Fallen allies add 10% damage each; 2+ Infiltrator, 4+ Inner Focus.

surgeconduit.name: Surge Conduit
surgeconduit.desc: This Pokemon has Electric Surge, Lightning Rod, and Brute Force's effects.
surgeconduit.shortDesc: Brute Force + Shadow Shield. Electric Surge + Lightning Rod + Brute Force.

sushitrick.name: Sushi Trick
sushitrick.desc: Hospitality. On entry, restores 1/4 of each adjacent ally's maximum HP and cures its confusion, with a cheerful sushi-service message.
sushitrick.shortDesc: Hospitality. On entry, restores 1/4 of each adjacent ally's HP and cures its confusion, with a cheerful sushi-service message.

swarmdrive.name: Swarm Drive
swarmdrive.desc: Has Swarm's full effect. Once per switch-in, knocking out a foe with a Bug-type move that does not switch the user out raises this Pokemon's Speed by one stage. U-turn and other pivot moves cannot trigger the Speed boost.
swarmdrive.shortDesc: Swarm; first non-pivot Bug-move KO each switch-in raises Speed by 1.

sweetdecay.name: Sweet Decay
sweetdecay.desc: This Pokemon has Hustle, Gluttony, Sweet Veil, and Corrosion's effects.

sweetresonance.name: Sweet Resonance
sweetresonance.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon has Supersweet Syrup, Self Sufficient, and Hydra Bond's effects, and gives its adjacent ally Dragon Cheer.
sweetresonance.shortDesc: Supersweet Syrup + Self Sufficient + Hydra Bond; ally gets Dragon Cheer on entry.

sweetsanctuary.name: Sweet Sanctuary
sweetsanctuary.desc: This Pokemon has Friend Guard, Sweet Veil, Aroma Veil, and Pastel Veil's effects.
sweetsanctuary.shortDesc: Friend Guard + Sweet Veil + Aroma Veil + Pastel Veil.

swiftdrill.name: Swift Drill
swiftdrill.desc: Swift Swim + Power Drill + Rain Dish. Doubles Speed in rain, strengthens drill and horn moves, and heals during rain.
swiftdrill.shortDesc: Swift Swim + Power Drill + Rain Dish.

templechime.name: Temple Chime
templechime.desc: Full Elevate (Levitate and highest-stat boosts after move KOs). Once per entry, Heal Bell actually curing at least one status also resets only the user's negative Special Defense stages. No additional healing.
templechime.shortDesc: Elevate + Levitate. Elevate; once/entry, a successful Heal Bell cure resets the user's negative SpD.

temporalshift.name: Temporal Shift
temporalshift.desc: This Pokemon's stats cannot be lowered by opposing Pokemon. On the turn after it uses a damaging move, it queues a 100 BP Future Sight matching its primary type against a random valid opposing target; multiple attacks can be queued and announce their strike turns.
temporalshift.shortDesc: Stats cannot be lowered; after attacking, queues 100 BP Temporal Shift Future Sight.

terragift.name: Terra Gift
terragift.desc: This Pokemon has Hospitality, Unaware, and Proficient's effects.

terraresolve.name: Terra Resolve
terraresolve.desc: This Pokemon has Stamina, Solid Rock, and Proficient's effects. Rocky Payload is removed.

territorial.name: Territorial
territorial.desc: Surviving an opposing physical hit charges its next Ground attack to ignore its own negative Attack stages and positive target evasion. Landing a Ground hit on a foe consumes the charge to heal 1/8 maximum HP. Misses and Protect preserve it; charges do not stack and switching clears them. Ground immunities still apply.
territorial.shortDesc: After surviving a physical hit, its next Ground hit ignores drops/evasion and heals 1/8.

thickfat.name: Thick Fat
thickfat.desc: If a Pokemon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon is immune to hail damage.
thickfat.shortDesc: Halves Fire/Ice damage stats and is immune to hail damage.

tidaldominion.name: Tidal Dominion
tidaldominion.desc: Swift Swim. Opponents with a lowered Speed stage cannot hit this Pokemon or its allies with priority moves. Pairs with G-Max Foam Burst's existing Speed drops.
tidaldominion.shortDesc: Swift Swim; foes with lowered Speed cannot use priority against its side.

tidaljaw.name: Tidal Jaw
tidaljaw.desc: This Pokemon has Strong Jaw, Swift Swim, Filter's effects.
tidaljaw.shortDesc: Strong Jaw + Swift Swim + Filter + Proficient.

tidalvoice.name: Tidal Voice
tidalvoice.desc: Liquid Voice: sound moves become Water-type (Ice on Icy Field) and gain 1.3x power, including already-Water moves such as Sparkling Aria. Sound moves spare allies. Its first damaging sound hit each entry clears its negative stat stages.
tidalvoice.shortDesc: Liquid Voice; sound moves gain 1.3x power, spare allies, and first hit clears stat drops.

tidalwave.name: Tidal Wave
tidalwave.desc: Water Absorb + Hydration + Rain Dish. Absorbs Water attacks, cures status in rain or water fields, and heals during rain. Does not heal on switching out.

titanpincer.name: Titan Pincer
titanpincer.desc: Hyper Cutter. Crabhammer and physical Steel-type moves use this Pokemon's Defense instead of Attack when its Defense is higher. Retains all Hyper Cutter effects.
titanpincer.shortDesc: Hyper Cutter. Crabhammer and physical Steel-type moves use its Defense instead of Attack when its Defense is higher. Retains all Hyper…

toxicarmor.name: Toxic Armor
toxicarmor.desc: This Pokemon has Venom Armor and Violent Rush's effects.

toxicbloom.name: Toxic Bloom
toxicbloom.desc: This Pokemon has Pollen Bloom and Self Sufficient. Its Poison-type attacks restore 1/4 of the damage they deal.
toxicbloom.shortDesc: Pollen Bloom + Self Sufficient + Proficient + Thick Fat. Pollen Bloom + Self Sufficient; Poison attacks heal 1/4 damage.

toxicevolution.name: Toxic Evolution
toxicevolution.desc: Corrosion + Dual Wield + Shield Dust + Levitate. Poisoned foes may be confused, attackers may be poisoned, and Ground moves do not affect the holder.
toxicevolution.shortDesc: Corrosion + Dual Wield + Shield Dust + Levitate.

toxicrenewal.name: Toxic Renewal
toxicrenewal.desc: Adaptability + Regenerator + Poison Touch. Same-type attacks deal more damage, switching out restores HP, and contact attacks can poison.

toxicserenity.name: Toxic Serenity
toxicserenity.desc: Poison Heal. While poisoned or badly poisoned, Dragon moves cannot miss. Retains the full Poison Heal effects.
toxicserenity.shortDesc: Poison Heal; Dragon moves cannot miss while poisoned.

toxicsink.name: Toxic Sink
toxicsink.desc: This Pokemon has Effect Spore and Invigorate. It redirects and absorbs Poison-type moves, raising its Attack and Special Attack by 1.
toxicsink.shortDesc: Effect Spore + Invigorate; absorbs Poison moves for +1 Atk/SpA.

toxicspines.name: Toxic Spines
toxicspines.desc: This Pokemon has Toxic Debris, Corrosion, and Merciless's effects.

trailbreaker.name: Trailbreaker
trailbreaker.desc: Immune to entry-hazard damage, Toxic Spikes poison and Sticky Web Speed drops. Rapid Spin can hit Ghost types.
trailbreaker.shortDesc: Immune to entry hazards. Rapid Spin can hit Ghost types.

treasuretitan.name: Treasure Titan
treasuretitan.desc: Filter + Earth Eater + Heavy Metal + Intimidate. Lowers adjacent foes' Attack on entry; Copperajah-Gmax's weight-based moves always use their maximum power.
treasuretitan.shortDesc: Filter + Earth Eater + Heavy Metal + Intimidate; max weight-move power.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.desc: Levitate + Resonance Force + Sand Force. This Pokemon's Bug-type attacks receive STAB. Damaging sound moves used by this Pokemon or its allies have 1.5x power; this Pokemon's sound moves use its higher offensive stat, and allies are protected from allied sound moves. In Sandstorm, Desert Terrain, or Ashen Beach Terrain, this Pokemon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type attacks have 1.3x power. This Pokemon is immune to sandstorm damage.
tremor.shortDesc: Levitate + Resonance Force + Sand Force; Bug attacks receive STAB.

triplethreat.name: Triple Threat
triplethreat.desc: Hydra Bond + Tangled Feet + Sniper + Keen Eye + Big Pecks. Its damaging single-target moves gain Hydra Bond's extra hits; the other components retain their usual conditions and field interactions.
triplethreat.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Tangled Feet + Sniper + Keen Eye + Big Pecks.

truedevotion.name: True Devotion
truedevotion.desc: This Pokemon has False Devotion and Technician's effects.
truedevotion.shortDesc: False Devotion + Serene Grace + Natural Recovery + Prankster + Technician.

truehydra.name: True Hydra
truehydra.desc: This Pokemon has Hydra Bond, Regenerator, Shed Skin, and Self Sufficient's effects. Eligible damaging moves hit three times, with the second and third hits at 30% damage. It heals 1/3 of its maximum HP on switching out, may shed status and other ailments at the end of a turn, heals 1/16 of its maximum HP each turn, and is immune to Sandstorm and Hail damage.
truehydra.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Regenerator + Shed Skin + Self Sufficient.

tundramarch.name: Tundra March
tundramarch.desc: Oblivious. Landing a Ground attack on a foe removes Spikes, Toxic Spikes and Sticky Web from its own side. Ground immunity, Protect and Substitute prevent this activation. Stealth Rock remains.
tundramarch.shortDesc: Oblivious; Ground hits remove Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web.

tyrantdomain.name: Tyrant Domain
tyrantdomain.desc: Sand Stream + Relic Armor + Supreme Overlord + Self Sufficient; Dragon's Den for 5 turns on faint. Shows "The Tyrant will persist" when it faints.
tyrantdomain.shortDesc: Sand Stream + Relic Armor + Supreme Overlord + Self Sufficient; Dragon's Den on faint.

tyrantstream.name: Tyrant Stream
tyrantstream.desc: This Pokemon has Brute Force, Sand Stream, and Strong Jaw's effects.
tyrantstream.shortDesc: Brute Force + Sand Stream + Strong Jaw.

ultrainstinct.name: Ultra Instinct
ultrainstinct.desc: Mold Breaker + Inner Focus. Attacks deal 2x damage through screens or 1.5x damage when the target has yet to move or has just switched in. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, or Cold Eclipse, it gains 1 Accuracy on entry, deals 1.5x damage, and takes 50% less damage. Otherwise it takes 70% less damage if the attacker has not yet moved. Bewitched Woods, Haunted, and Holy Field suppress these effects.
ultrainstinct.shortDesc: Mold Breaker + Inner Focus; screen and timing boosts; field defenses.

unboundblaze.name: Unbound Blaze
unboundblaze.desc: This Pokemon has Dragonize and Magma Armor's effects. It is immune to Hail damage. At the end of each turn, opposing Pokemon take Fire-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, doubled if burned or if this Pokemon used a Fire- or Dragon-type move this turn. This damage is blocked by Fire immunities. Only in Free-for-All does Fire type effectiveness scale this chip.
unboundblaze.shortDesc: Proficient. Dragonize + Magma Armor; Fire chip scales by type in FFA.

uncheckedassault.name: Unchecked Assault
uncheckedassault.desc: Scrappy + Striker + Opportunist + Limber. Technician is removed.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.desc: Water Absorb, including its field effects. Damaging Water hits ground surviving foes as with Smack Down. Does not trap them or bypass protection, Substitute or Water immunity.
undertow.shortDesc: Water Absorb; Water hits ground surviving foes.

unleashedego.name: Unleashed Ego
unleashedego.desc: This Pokemon has Ultra Ego, Levitate, and Raging Storm's effects.

unovavanguard.name: Unova Vanguard
unovavanguard.desc: This Pokemon has Violent Rush and Wind Rider's effects.

unovawing.name: Unova Wing
unovawing.desc: Critical-hit and Competitive effects; no Unburden. Stat drops can raise Special Attack, but item use or loss no longer doubles Speed.
unovawing.shortDesc: Super Luck + Competitive. Critical-hit and Competitive effects; no Unburden.

unstableevo.name: Unstable Evo
unstableevo.desc: Eevee-Starter's IVs carry through form changes. Before using a Let's Go move, it changes into the matching evolution and uses that form's stats, typing, and Speed. It keeps Unstable Evo, Filter, and Self Sufficient, and gains both of the evolution's listed Ability effects. Switching out restores Eevee-Starter. It cannot use battle gimmicks or hold Eevium Z.
unstableevo.shortDesc: Filter + Self Sufficient; Let's Go moves change form and grant two Ability effects; no gimmicks.

unyielding.name: Unyielding
unyielding.desc: Stamina, including this server's Defense increase once per turn and 1/16 healing per opposing hit. While its Defense stage is positive, opponents cannot force it to switch. Normal switching and stat resets still work.
unyielding.shortDesc: Stamina; while Defense is raised, foes cannot force it out.

updraft.name: Updraft
updraft.desc: Flying moves ignore evasion boosts. Once per switch-in, its first Flying attack to damage a foe raises an adjacent ally's Speed by 1 stage.
updraft.shortDesc: Flying moves ignore evasion boosts; first Flying hit per entry boosts an ally’s Speed.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.desc: Intimidate; Extreme Speed has 1.5x power and becomes Fire when its matchup is better, including against Normal immunity. Direct single-target opposing HP damage grants one 50% guard against the next damaging hit from that opponent that turn. After a successful attack, lethal damage can trigger a once-per-battle final stand: all direct and residual damage leaves at least 1 HP for the rest of that turn. Does not prevent non-damage faint effects. No extra critical-hit reward, permanent indirect immunity or stat-drop protection.
vanguard.shortDesc: Intimidate; enhanced Extreme Speed; one-foe guard and once-per-battle final stand.

vendetta.name: Vendetta
vendetta.desc: This Pokemon has Anger Point, Second Wind, and Self Sufficient's effects.
vendetta.shortDesc: Anger Point + Second Wind + Self Sufficient.

venomarmor.name: Venom Armor
venomarmor.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon becomes poisoned if it has no status, even if it is Steel-type. This Pokemon has Poison Heal and Dual Wield's effects. While poisoned, its physical damage is multiplied by 1.3. Metal Claw has 1.5x power.
venomarmor.shortDesc: Self-poisons on switch-in; Poison Heal + Dual Wield; poisoned physical damage 1.3x; Metal Claw 1.5x.

venombastion.name: Venom Bastion
venombastion.desc: Stamina, including Defense gains once per turn and this server's 1/16 healing per opposing hit. Once per turn, a poisoned foe that damages it loses one stage of its higher offensive stat. No separate Bug power boost, Merciless or Self Sufficient.
venombastion.shortDesc: Stamina; poisoned attackers lose 1 stage of their higher offense once per turn.

venomheal.name: Venom Heal
venomheal.desc: This Pokemon has Hyper Cutter, Poison Heal, and Poison Point's effects. Its Poison-type moves have 1.5x STAB.
venomheal.shortDesc: Hyper Cutter + Poison Heal + Poison Point; Poison moves get 1.5x STAB.

venomveil.name: Venom Veil
venomveil.desc: Liquid Ooze + Corrosion + Water Veil. Draining this Pokemon damages the user instead of healing it; its moves can poison Steel- and Poison-type targets; it gains Water Veil's burn protection, field interactions, and Aqua Ring on entry. Only Corrosion's Poison immunity bypass and move modification apply; poisoning a foe does not lower its defenses.

verdantdrake.name: Verdant Drake
verdantdrake.desc: Same-type attacks gain 1.3x power. Dual Wield makes moves boosted by Sharpness or Mega Launcher, plus arrow moves, hit twice for reduced damage. Regenerator restores 1/3 max HP on switching out. Lightning Rod draws in and absorbs Electric moves, raising Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage; Electric Terrain also grants these boosts on entry.
verdantdrake.shortDesc: Proficient + Dual Wield + Regenerator + Lightning Rod. 1.3x same-type moves; Dual Wield + Regenerator + Lightning Rod.

verdantedge.name: Verdant Edge
verdantedge.desc: Chlorophyll + Sharpness + Grass Pelt. Boosts Speed in sun, slicing damage, and Defense on grassy fields. Invigorate is removed.

verdanthospitality.name: Verdant Hospitality
verdanthospitality.desc: This Pokemon has Friend Guard's effect. On switch-in, it restores 1/8 of its ally's max HP. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its max HP and its ally restores 1/16 of its max HP.
verdanthospitality.shortDesc: Proficient. Friend Guard; heals ally on switch-in; heals self and ally each turn.

verdantsanctuary.name: Verdant Sanctuary
verdantsanctuary.desc: On entry, sets Grassy Terrain and heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP. Healing received by this Pokemon and its allies is multiplied by 1.3. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon has a 50% chance to cure each adjacent ally's status. Allies also take 3/4 damage from attacks.
verdantsanctuary.shortDesc: Grassy Surge + Invigorate + Hospitality + Friend Guard.

voidveil.name: Void Veil
voidveil.desc: Levitate + Magic Guard + Insomnia. Immune to Ground moves, indirect damage, sleep, and Yawn; Dark- and Ghost-type moves have 1.3x power. In Fairy Tale, raises Sp. Def by 1 on entry. Its first Dark- or Ghost-type attack each switch-in bypasses Substitute and screens. It does not heal or shelter allies.
voidveil.shortDesc: Levitate + Magic Guard + Insomnia; first Dark/Ghost attack pierces Substitute and screens.

voltabsorb.name: Volt Absorb
voltabsorb.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.
voltabsorb.shortDesc: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.

warpath.name: War Path
warpath.desc: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, hail damage, sandstorm damage, and flinching. Its moves have 1.3x accuracy and damaging moves have 1.3x power. Its Attack is 1.5x while statused; burn still reduces its physical damage normally. It takes 25% less damage from attacks. Its Rock-, Fighting-, and Ground-type moves and drill or horn moves bypass screens and Substitute and ignore defensive stat stages. When attacking, it ignores the target's Defense, Sp. Def, and evasion stages; when defending, it ignores the attacker's Attack, Sp. Atk, and accuracy stages.
warpath.shortDesc: Powder/weather/flinch immunity; accuracy/power 1.3x; status Atk 1.5x; attacks deal 25% less; stage/bypass effects.

warship.name: War Ship
warship.desc: This Pokemon has Swift Swim, Solid Rock, and Strong Jaw's effects. Its Speed is doubled in rain. It takes reduced damage from attacks, and bite-based moves have 1.5x power.
warship.shortDesc: Swift Swim + Solid Rock + Strong Jaw.

wastingsurge.name: Wasting Surge
wastingsurge.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon sets Wasteland Terrain. On Water Surface or Underwater, it creates Murkwater Surface instead; from Underwater, non-Poison and non-Steel Pokemon that are not semi-invulnerable faint. If Neutralization is active on Water Surface or Underwater, this effect fails. This Pokemon also has Byxbysion Touch's effects.
wastingsurge.shortDesc: Sets Wasteland/Murkwater; Underwater KOs non-Poison/Steel; Byxbysion Touch.

waterabsorb.name: Water Absorb
waterabsorb.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.
waterabsorb.shortDesc: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.

waterbarrage.name: Water Barrage
waterbarrage.desc: This Pokemon has Dual Wield's effects. At the end of each turn, opposing Pokemon take cycling Water damage of 1/16, 2/16, then 3/16 max HP, blocked by Water immunities. Only in Free-for-All does Water type effectiveness scale this chip.
waterbarrage.shortDesc: Proficient. Dual Wield; cycling Water chip scales by type in FFA.

waterbubble.name: Water Bubble
waterbubble.desc: This Pokemon gains Water STAB, and its offensive stat is doubled while using Water attacks. Fire attacks against it use half the attacker's offensive stat. It also has Water Veil's effects.
waterbubble.shortDesc: Water STAB/offense 2x; Fire offense 0.5x; Water Veil.

wickedcommand.name: Wicked Command
wickedcommand.desc: This Pokemon has Insomnia and Super Luck's effects and takes 20% less damage from other Pokemon's damaging moves. If this Pokemon knocks out an enemy with a move, its higher attacking stat is raised by 1 stage, with Attack chosen on a tie.
wickedcommand.shortDesc: Insomnia + Super Luck; move KOs boost the higher attacking stat.

wickedsnare.name: Wicked Snare
wickedsnare.desc: This Pokemon has Stakeout, Tangling Hair, and Prankster's effects.

windchime.name: Wind Chime
windchime.desc: This Pokemon has Armorize, Punk Rock, and Levitate's effects.

windysurge.name: Windy Surge
windysurge.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon sets Tailwind on its side for 2 turns.
windysurge.shortDesc: On switch-in, sets 2-turn Tailwind on this Pokemon's side.

wingedwraith.name: Winged Wraith
wingedwraith.desc: This Pokemon has Infiltrator and Gale Wings' effects.

witheringshell.name: Withering Shell
witheringshell.desc: This Pokemon has Crumbling Shell, Natural Recovery, and Sturdy's effects. Physical hits set Stealth Rock on the attacker's side except in water fields. It cures status and restores exactly 1/3 max HP when switching out, with no extra healing for curing status. If it is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP, and OHKO moves fail.

wonderguard.name: Wonder Guard
wonderguard.desc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
wonderguard.shortDesc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.

woolyconductor.name: Wooly Conductor
woolyconductor.desc: This Pokemon has Fluffy, Mold Breaker, and Static's effects. It takes half damage from contact moves, but takes double damage from Fire moves. Its moves ignore opposing Abilities, and contact moves used against it may paralyze the attacker.

wrathshield.name: Wrath Shield
wrathshield.desc: This Pokemon has Bulletproof, Dauntless Shield, and Self Repair's effects. It gains 1 Defense stage on entry, plus 1 Special Defense stage in Cold Eclipse, New World, Starlight Arena, or Fairy Tale. It is immune to bullet and pulse moves and restores HP through Self Repair.
wrathshield.shortDesc: Bulletproof + Dauntless Shield + Self Repair + Proficient. Bulletproof + Dauntless Shield + Self Repair; boosted fields also give +1 SpD.

wreckingball.name: Wrecking Ball
wreckingball.desc: Sturdy + Self Sufficient + Crumbling Shell. At full HP, survives one otherwise lethal move and blocks OHKO moves. Heals each turn and can set Stealth Rock after a physical hit.

zen.name: Zen
zen.desc: Water Absorb + Unaware + Damp. Absorbs Water moves, ignores relevant stat boosts, and prevents explosive moves.

auroraveil.name: Aurora Veil
auroraveil.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.
auroraveil.shortDesc: For 5 turns, damage to allies halved. Snow only.

batonpass.name: Baton Pass
batonpass.desc: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.
batonpass.shortDesc: User switches, passing stat changes and more.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

darkpulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
darkpulse.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

defog.name: Defog
defog.desc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.
defog.shortDesc: -1 evasion; ends user and target hazards/terrain.

destinybond.name: Destiny Bond
destinybond.desc: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.
destinybond.shortDesc: If an opponent knocks out the user, it also faints.

encore.name: Encore
encore.desc: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.
encore.shortDesc: Target repeats its last move for its next 3 turns.

flipturn.name: Flip Turn
flipturn.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
flipturn.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.

fly.name: Fly
fly.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids most attacks. If Tailwind is active on the user's side, this move attacks immediately and has a high critical hit ratio.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.desc: As long as the target remains active, its positive evasiveness stat stage is ignored and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit it if it is a Ghost type. The user also takes half damage from Ghost-type attacks until it switches out. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Miracle Eye or Odor Sleuth.
foresight.shortDesc: Normal/Fighting hit Ghost; ignores Evasion; user resists Ghost.

futuresight.name: Future Sight
futuresight.desc: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.
futuresight.shortDesc: Hits two turns after being used.

genesissupernova.name: Genesis Supernova
genesissupernova.desc: If this move is successful, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain.

gmaxcuddle.name: G-Max Cuddle
gmaxcuddle.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. This move is Fairy type. If this move is successful, opposing Pokemon have their Attack and Special Attack lowered by 1 stage, and the user and its ally restore 1/8 of their maximum HP.
gmaxcuddle.shortDesc: Fairy. Foes: -1 Atk/SpA. User and ally heal 1/8.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.desc: Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that move loses all its remaining PP.
grudge.shortDesc: If the user faints, the attack used loses all its PP.

hail.name: Hail
hail.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type or have the Ice Body, Magic Guard, Overcoat, or Snow Cloak Abilities. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Hail.

kingsshield.name: King's Shield
kingsshield.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Attack lowered by 1 stage. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
kingsshield.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -1 Atk.

leechseed.name: Leech Seed
leechseed.desc: The Pokemon at the user's position steals 1/8 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. If Big Root is held by the recipient, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue being leeched. If the target switches out or uses Mortal Spin or Rapid Spin successfully, the effect ends. Grass-type Pokemon are immune to this move on use, but not its effect.
leechseed.shortDesc: 1/8 of target's HP is restored to user every turn.

magicpowder.name: Magic Powder
magicpowder.desc: Causes the target to become a Psychic type and creates Bewitched Field for 5 turns. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Psychic type, or if the target is Terastallized.
magicpowder.shortDesc: Changes the target's type to Psychic; creates Bewitched Field.

maxlightning.name: Max Lightning
maxlightning.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Electric Terrain begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxlightning.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Electric Terrain.

maxmindstorm.name: Max Mindstorm
maxmindstorm.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Psychic Terrain begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxmindstorm.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Psychic Terrain.

maxovergrowth.name: Max Overgrowth
maxovergrowth.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxovergrowth.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Grassy Terrain.

maxstarfall.name: Max Starfall
maxstarfall.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Misty Terrain begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxstarfall.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Misty Terrain.

miracleeye.name: Miracle Eye
miracleeye.desc: As long as the target remains active, its positive evasiveness stat stage is ignored and Psychic-type attacks can hit it if it is a Dark type. The user also takes half damage from Ghost-type attacks until it switches out. On Psychic Terrain, Fairy Tale Field, and Holy Field, the user's Special Attack rises by 2 stages. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Foresight or Odor Sleuth.
miracleeye.shortDesc: Psychic hits Dark; ignores Evasion; user resists Ghost; field +2 SpA.

odorsleuth.name: Odor Sleuth
odorsleuth.desc: As long as the target remains active, its positive evasiveness stat stage is ignored and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit it if it is a Ghost type. The user also takes half damage from Ghost-type attacks until it switches out. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Foresight or Miracle Eye.
odorsleuth.shortDesc: Normal/Fighting hit Ghost; ignores Evasion; user resists Ghost.

rapidspin.name: Rapid Spin
rapidspin.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
rapidspin.shortDesc: Free user from hazards/bind/Leech Seed; +1 Spe.

roar.name: Roar
roar.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
roar.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

rockclimb.name: Rock Climb
rockclimb.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this move hits a confused target, the user's Attack and Speed rise by 1 stage. On Mountain, Rocky, Cave, and Desert fields, this move has a high critical hit ratio.
rockclimb.shortDesc: 30% confuse. Vs confused: +Atk/Spe. +crit on rough fields.

rocksmash.name: Rock Smash
rocksmash.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. If this lowers Defense, the user's next Fighting-, Rock-, or Ground-type move against that target deals 1.3x damage. If the target already has lowered Defense, this move hits twice.
rocksmash.shortDesc: 50% -1 Def; next hit 1.3x. Hits twice if Def is down.

slackoff.name: Slack Off
slackoff.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
slackoff.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
spikes.shortDesc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.

stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthrock.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
stealthrock.shortDesc: Hurts foes on switch-in. Factors Rock weakness.

strengthsap.name: Strength Sap
strengthsap.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.
strengthsap.shortDesc: User heals HP=target's Atk stat. Lowers Atk by 1.

swordsdance.name: Swords Dance
swordsdance.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
taunt.shortDesc: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.

toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicspikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.
toxicspikes.shortDesc: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.

trickroom.name: Trick Room
trickroom.desc: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
trickroom.shortDesc: Goes last. For 5 turns, turn order is reversed.

anomalycore.name: Anomaly Core
anomalycore.desc: If held by a designated Pulse or Rift Pokemon, this Anomaly Core allows it to undergo its Pulse or Rift Evolution in battle.
anomalycore.shortDesc: Pulse/Rift Evolution item for designated Anomaly Pokemon.

choiceband.name: Choice Band
choiceband.desc: Holder's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choiceband.shortDesc: Holder's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

choicescarf.name: Choice Scarf
choicescarf.desc: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choicescarf.shortDesc: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

choicespecs.name: Choice Specs
choicespecs.desc: Holder's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choicespecs.shortDesc: Holder's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
